WEIRD DREAMS

Chapter One

Day broke over Plymouth, bringing a slow grey sky, damp morose streets and damp morose milkmen, finished off by a minor surge in the electricity supply as quarter of a million clock radios turned on to the early morning show.

Waking up is hard to do, thought Steve. Radio playing, birds singing, Monday morning. He sighed, turned over, and without opening his eyes hit the radio right on the snooze button. That'd teach it. Another five minutes wouldn't hurt...

But radios are made of sterner stuff. Five minutes later, unbowed by such early morning violence, it resumed its unspeakable pop. Which turned, in time, unto unpalatable news. Yawn... He really should get up now, or he'd have to run for the bus again. Strange - his usual warm sleepiness was mixed with something else...

Two records after the news. He really had to get up now. Least disgusting pair of boxer shorts, that shirt would do for today, and into the bathroom to shave his teeth... breakfast, paper and irresponsible TV weathermen later, Steve had diagnosed his problem.

He was feeling a bit peaky, as his mum would've said had she not been living in North Dakota. Nothing worse than that. Still, Steve mused, perhaps he was coming down with the flu. Perhaps he ought to get something for it. To really get Monday going, among the junk mail was a note from his dentist reminding him of his six-monthly checkup. Which was, he noticed, tomorrow. Super.

He ran for the bus, went upstairs and he read the paper, then trudged the ten minute walk from stop to work. Wet pavements and grey skies - it wasn't actually raining, but that was only a matter of time - did nothing to remove his malaise. In the office, he mentioned his lack of well-being to Emily, a bright girl in the postroom he'd got his eye on. He had often wondered whether he should ask her out but, just as often, decided not to. Never know, keep the friendship going and who knows what might happen? He'd never noticed, which was a bit insensitive on his part, that Emily was bored with life. More importantly, and this really wasn't his fault, he'd never noticed that she was a bored daemon. One of those mythical creatures who spend their eternal lives pushing misery, evil and discord.

Emily hadn't started out as a daemon, few people do; her body had been possessed by the spirit Zelloripus as she waited out her punishment. Three thousand years ago, Zelloripus had been banished from the Central Circle of the court of Asklarioum in Chael for a crime against fellow daemons. A crime so despicable that, had it worked, she would have challenged the Great One herself.

Given human form and stripped of many of her daemonic powers, she was sent to live the life of a mortal being on one of the less pleasant planets, Earth. As each host body died, she hopped into a new one, taking over the mind and feeding on the soul. Three thousand years into her sentence, with three thousand more to go, she was not happy. Sixty centuries in Plymouth is enough to embitter anyone. Even one whose residual evilness could, if focussed, melt a toddler's ice cream from a distance of ten miles.

Today there were many puddles of Guiseppi's Famous Italian Ice Cream on the pavements of Plymouth. For today was special. Exactly half-way through Zelloripus' exile, she was feeling mean and ornery and disposed to high mischief. She despised the humans whose form she took; they by and large achieved oblivion in just seventy short years. She especially despised Steve, whose somnolent form sonorously snoring through lunchbreaks was a continual reminder of a contented peace of mind denied her.

Daemons don't sleep; chances are that Another lurks nearby with designs on their soulstuff. A diabolic doze is the best they can normally manage; even this is denied those cast out of Hades because of the forces of Good that are on constant watch. Even, it had to be said, in Plymouth, where three thousand years of sleepless nights and boring days were driving Zelloripus close to breaking point. So far, she'd stuck to the rules, because using what remained of her powers to tamper with mortal affairs could double or treble her stay on Earth. But only if she was detected; the temptation to lash out at something or someone was growing. Her current job, with Plymouth's third most succesfful producer of soap, was not helping things.

So mere bad timing could explain Steve's unhappy encounter with Zelloripus, or Emily as she should be called, on this day in particular. Maybe it was just bad luck that accounted for the copious yawns, heavy eyelids and sleep-slurred voice with which he laced the conversation over her franking machine. But the following conversation was almost too bad to be true...

"Hiya Emily," said Steve. "You're looking wide eyed for a Monday morning. Wish I could be so awake, but I've been in bed most of the weekend."

"Poor soul." said Emily, "What's the matter?"

"Oh, I dunno. Think it's a touch of the flu; all I can do is sleep. It was a real effort to get up today. You don't know of anything that could perk me up a bit, do you?"

Emily, bitter from boredom, was close to the edge. "No," she said "I don't usually get that sort of problem. With sleeping, I mean."

It was probably his attempt at humour, or maybe it was a particularly clumsy chat-up line, that did it. "Perhaps you should sleep with me - it would maybe rub off a little. There's nothing like a good night's kip to make your fellow man seem a bit nicer..."

"I'm sure" said Emily with a smile so sharp it was opening the letters, "that you're right there. Tell me, Steve, do you dream?"

"Dream? No, can't say that I do. Not that I remember, that is. But if I did, it would be of you."

"How sweet. Perhaps I can help you, at least" and here the smile was diamond-tipped "with the flu. I think I might just have something in my handbag. Hold on, let me go and get it."

Steve was pleased. It might be worth asking her out after all, let's see, there's the funfair out of town... no, she's too bright for that... Outside, the weak sunlight darkened for a moment, as if a cloud had passed.

She came back. "Here we are, something I got from a drug store last time I had the flu." It was a small brown bottle, with an indistinct label and, just visible in the powdery interior, three white pills. "You're supposed to have them before a meal, just take the lot tonight with a bottle of red wine and some cheese and you'll be a new man."

"Thanks very much, Emily" said Steve, taking the bottle from her hand. "I'll do that. Look, what are you doing this weekend? Do you fancy a trip to see the new Stallone film or something?"
"I'm not sure" lied the being with three thousand years' worth of identical Plymothian weekends stretched out in front of her. "Let's see how you're feeling in a couple of days. Wouldn't want to over-exert you during your convalescence".

"Oh, I'm sure I'll be fine. I don't think I'll change my mind!"

"We'll see" said Emily, allowing just a hint of cold, evil-tinged boredom to slip out.

That evening, Steve wondered about Emily's last words. There was something not quite right, he decided, and came to a similar conclusion about the thrice-microwaved chilli con carne sitting in a bowl in the fridge. Then he remembered that wine and cheese had been recommended, and, although he was feeling fine by now, he thought that taking the lady's medicine followed by a triumphal Tuesday morning could do no harm. He had the cheese, and trotted out to the nearest 7-11 to get a bottle of red wine.

Back at home, he emptied the three pills out of the bottle into his hand. Nothing special, thought he, and with a flourish popped them into his mouth and washed them down with a long draft of Burgundy. The cheese sandwich followed. A quick scan of the TV pages - why is there never anything on a Monday night? - convinced him of the desirability of bed.

It's not generally appreciated that much magic is real, test-tubed and white-coated, science. Merlin's laboratory technique would have brought murmurs of approval from Pasteur, and watching Shiva smite (from a safe distance) might well have enlightened Einstein still further. It's just that while the great unwashed mass of men were more interested in squabbling, sex and smallpox it contented the Immortals to hide their rational prowess behind a web of mystic mishmash.

Sure, there is magic to be had, but using it brings many repercussions which might not be completely controllable. Many magicians had lost their souls in the long research programme which, although almost half as old as the Universe, was still not producing results. But boy, was it over budget. Some of its more spectacular failures were still puzzling astronomers from a thousand worlds; more than few of whom were unexpected by-products from an experiment or two themselves.

Emily was especially wary of employing the Dark Art. Not only had it landed her in this mess in the first place, but its use could signal loud and clear her position to any number of undesirable companions from the busybodies at Asklarioum, or something far more sinister. As it was, materialising the pills had been risky enough. Her excellent knowledge of human biochemistry helped her from there.

As Steve dropped off to sleep, the pills were lying inert in his stomach. Slowly the gastric acid ate away the outer case, and the compounds within began to diffuse out. And what compounds, the like of which had not been seen on Earth before or (it is safe to assume) since. Any chemist worth his NaCl would have given his spatula to have been in on the action.

First, the long chain molecules from the cheese were broken down to several interesting substances. The alcohol from the wine helped carry these and others from the pills themselves to the stomach wall, through which they slipped like Mexicans into Texas. On the other side of the wall, the usual gang of enzymes were waiting to digest the evening meal; but they weren't ready for what came at them. The scene of chemical carnage was brutal but short.

Past the first stage of digestion, the intruding substances reached the blood stream. Dissolved in the plasma, they drifted up until they got to Steve's brain. The blood brain barrier - that wonderful filter that keeps hunks of pizza molecule out while letting oxygen in - was as effective as a traffic cop against a battalion of Soviet tanks. Emily's dark designs began their invidious work.

Steve's brain was defenceless against the chemical onslaught. The vast, and mostly unused, network of neurones lay in front of them. Even as the last molecules were arriving, the compounds got to work. They diddled the dopamine receptors, they speeded up the cortical synapses, they nobbled the noradrenaline. A thin web of complex bonds spread deep into Steve's cerebellum, like frost over a tree. Further and further they went, until every part of his brain was invaded and controlled. For the moment they did nothing, but somewhere else in the Plymothian night a small chuckle of anticipation bounced off the flock wallpaper. In his sleep, Steve stirred and shivered.

Chapter 2

The next day, Steve woke up, as usual, to the clock radio. Unusually, he found himself listening to it, and, even more strangely, it annoyed him. He turned over in bed and thumped the switch, leaving the bedroom to the birds, noisy Fords and myriad other sounds of morning. He stared at the ceiling. Hangover? No, he'd only had a couple of glasses of wine last night. Anyway, his head didn't hurt and he felt all right, sort of, except... He was wide awake. That was odd, too, as most days he only started to really wake up on the bus into work.

He glanced at the clock radio; he still had a good half-hour until he had to leave, so he tried to doze. As he closed his eyes, the world spun. About fifteen years ago, he'd gone to Scotland with his parents, and once he'd crawled up to the edge of a granite cliff and peered over at the rocks and sea hundreds of feet beneath. He remembered amazement, awe and no little fear, but most of all he remembered the spiralling vertigo. That was what he was feeling now - he gripped the sides of the bed and opened his eyes rapidly, sweating.

The flu? Those pills he took last night? Could be, but he'd never been ill like that before, nor taken anything from a chemist that shook him up so badly. For a moment he was worried, but then the morning took over again, and the sound of a bus pulling up the hill reminded and reassured him that another normal day was waiting. He got out of bed and, standing up, felt fine once more. The coffee and eggs of breakfast tasted really good, but he didn't feel like reading his paper on the bus. For some reason, he wasn't interested in "Rock Star Eats Own Hand, Sells Guitar", which seemed to be the most earthshaking intelligence on offer. Back in the office, he homed in on Emily.

"Hey, Emily" he said "Those pills seemed to have done the trick. No flu, not a sniffle. I'm feeling really awake. They're good stuff - what're they called? I'd like to get some, just for next time, you know?"

She giggled, a short, high-pitched stutter like a pony neighing. "Glad they seem to have worked, Steve. I can't remember their name, though, I've had them for a while. Still, if it comes back to me I'll let you know."

"You've usually got such a good memory, Emily" said Steve ingratiatingly. "Me, mine's like a sieve. Can't even remember things like buying milk or doctor's appointments. Oh no!"

"What's up?" asked Emily, wondering for a moment whether she'd miscalculated something and wondering, just for a moment, what exactly she'd done. Just for a moment, and then she realised. "Forgotten an appointment?"

"Dentist. What's the time? Look, I've got to rush. See you at lunch - if I've got any teeth left" And he dashed into the boss' office to explain his impending absence.

He rushed out of the building. His dentist was about a half a mile away, and by walking fast he could make it. Past the bombed church in the roundabout, past the police station, up the hill, past the library, past the reservoir and into Dr V. Sells, known since childhood as Dr Weasel. The receptionist looked through her window - hello <PRESIDIO_ANONYMIZED_PERSON>, hello Mr Trevathen take a seat he's running a little late - and he dived into the piles of House and Garden from 1972.

Back in the office, the morning post had been sorted and distributed, and there was, as usual, half-an-hour's hiatus before the pre-lunch mailbags came in. Jill went out to round up all the outgoing mail from the seven floors, leaving Emily to herself. She checked her watch, and felt the sea of infinite boredom recede a little. Any minute now, and the first part of her plan would start to work.

Deep within Steve's brain, profound changes were taking place. The tendrils of diabolic chemistry insinuated into his hippocampus, a small lump of grey matter normally concerned with sorting Steve's experience (such as they were) into long-term recall, and started to subtly rewire his memory mechanisms. Large portions of his mind were converted into the biological equivalent of RAM; ready to record experiences and, having recorded them, control his mind as a program controls a computer's processor. Elsewhere similar changes were taking place, but for now things were ready just to record. Just for now.

The triggers to load the program were complex. If Steve was interested, then whatever it was that held his interest would be sorted, stored, activated. If he was frightened, amused, intrigued, it would all be recorded. But for this to work, he had to be capable of taking an interest in the first place. So part of Emily's chemical mishmash sharpened his wits, heightened his awareness, upped his IQ to just short of genius. This, she thought, was a nice move. Not only did it ensure that the data recorded would be powerful and particularly apt, but when the second stage began he would be only too capable of, mmmm, appreciating what was happening to him. He might even fight back, which would round off the whole thing nicely. And, she though with a daemonic delight, it would serve him right to be given a glimpse of what it's like to have an intelligence confronted with infinite boredom.

Steve was, as the plan demanded, unaware of the mental mayhem crystallising beneath his cranium. But he was getting painfully aware of a lot of other things as he sat in the formica and chipboard waiting room. The posters of rabbits noshing carrots and jaunty poems about plaque ("Clean Clean Clean your teeth! Or else the germs get underneath!") were fading and a couple flapped loose at the corners. They'd been there since he'd started seeing Dr Weasel, and, he mused, the place probably hadn't seen a touch of paint for ten years before that.

The bright orange and grey polypropelene bucket chairs finished of a fine example of early 'sixties public health design. Now why did he think that? He'd been here every six months for years, and usually only worried about whether he'd get a filling or not. Those old magazines - did people really think that the ideal home looked like that? The clothes they wore in the photos looked laughable too, but he could remember when he'd thought they looked good. How strange... perhaps the jacket and jeans he was wearing now would be equally ridiculous in ten years time.

The buzzer chainsawed its way into his daydreams, and the receptionist looked up. "Mr Trevathen?". He stood up, and went into the surgery. Dr Sells was shuffling through some papers at a desk, and the Chair sat in the middle of the room beneath the usual battery of technology.

"Hello Steve", said the dentist. "Sit down please. Now then, any problems since last time? It's good to see you keeping these checkups. Some people just don't bother after they leave home, and when something goes wrong there are all sorts of things to put right. How's your mother, by the way? It was America she moved to, wasn't it?"

As usual, Steve had to wait for three or four questions to go past before he could get a word in. "Yes, she's settled down in North Dakota and she's doing fine. I might go over to see her at Christmas. My teeth are OK, too, but I wouldn't want to miss anything that needs looking at."

"A fine attitude. Now then, lie down and open up."

Steve looked up at the light. "That's new, isn't it? The old one was a different colour."

"That's right, very observant! This one's a new low-voltage design, much more reliable and brighter too. I don't think anyone else has noticed. Open wide."

The nurse hooked in some suction, and went to get Steve's notes.

"Three's OK, two's OK, one's OK, one's OK, two's OK, three's OK, filling on four's a little bitty; we'll sort that out..."

Dr Sells continued chanting his litany as Steve noticed, for the first time it seemed, the antiseptic smell, the faint noise of the machinery behind the dentist, the charts on the wall and the rows of dentures on the shelves. He felt the faint scratching inside his head as the dentist probed away. As Steve had forgotten about the appointment, he hadn't given his teeth the customary vigourous pre-checkup brushing and this was apparently noticeable.

"Hello, we haven't been very thorough with your brushing, have we?" Typical quack, though Steve, lapsing into patronising parental tones. Doctor knows best. "Well, there's a cavity just starting on one of your premolars, and a slightly messy filling to tidy up. We'll have a poke around and fix them."

Steve had collected a lot of fillings from a chocolate childhood, and had the memories to match. As various instruments of torture were produced and whined, sucked and scrunched their way around his mouth, he remembered the old fears with a vividness that surprised him. He winced as the drill scoured the cavity, and was very relieved at the instruction to rinse and spit. Strange taste, this pink liquid.

"While I was fixing those teeth, Steve, I spotted something that might be serious. I'd better have a look at it."

This was new. He opened his mouth obediently, and became more apprehensive as Dr Sell's usual banter failed to intersperse his dental deliberations. Finally the dentist stood up, and Steve closed his mouth.

"One of your molars is misplaced - I don't know why I didn't catch it before, but there you go. Normally I'd leave it, as it's been there for years without causing any problems, but there are signs that you've got some more teeth coming through underneath."

"Eh? You mean I'm teething?"

"No, not quite. It's not uncommon for some people to have a third set of teeth at some time during their lives, and you might be one of them. In any case, I should really get that molar out otherwise it could be very bad for your jaw. It's not really fair that you should have to have a tooth pulled, since you're one of my better patients, but it's a good thing I caught it. Gas or needle?"

He means it, Steve thought. He hadn't had a tooth out before, and the prospect frightened him. Adrenalin started to seep into his blood stream. His heart speeded up, but in his brain the new mechanisms fired up and channelled the stream of his senses into the almost infinite capacity of the revamped memory.

"Oh, gas I think. Is it dangerous?"

"No, not very." Oh, how reassuring, what soothing Weasel words.

"Is the needle safer?"

"There's nothing to worry about with either method. But the gas hurts less."

"Fine. Will it take long?"

"About half an hour, and you should be OK within the hour. Not driving, are you?"

"I walked here."

"No problems then. You might find things a bit fuzzy for a while, but it wears off."

Steve remembered something Emily had said, and for the first time felt sadness for a thing which had never happened.

"Will I dream?"

"Hard to day. Some people do, but most don't."

The nurse had been tinkering with a mess of tubes and cylinders, and brought it to the side of the Chair. While she prepared a tray of gleaming steel instruments, some of which Steve thought would look more in keeping in his local garage, Dr Sells continued his spiel.

"Now then, I'll want you to breath deeply from the mask while counting to ten. You won't get past about seven, but you won't notice that. Ready, Sandra?"

The nurse passed over a facemask, which the dentist placed over Steve's mouth.

"Righty-ho - start breathing and counting. Sweet dreams!"

Here we go, then. One... suck... two... blow... three... suck... four... blow... hmmm, this is quite pleasant... where was I... teeth...

In the surgery, the dentist checked Steve's pulse, eyes and respiration. Satisifed that his patient was well under, he gave him a few seconds more and started to prepare for oral excavation.

Back at the office, Jill wanted to know what Emily was finding so funny. Emily merely giggled, and carried on sorting the post. All that day, she'd be in high spirits, surprising those who were used to her normal sarcastic mood. To those who asked why, she'd reply only that 'Life's a gas, isn't it?'

Setting: Central Hong Kong, 1980s. The scene takes place on a crowded street near a bustling night market. Various street vendors sell a variety of scrumptious local delicacies. The aroma fills the air, and a cacophony of laughter and chattering surround the scene. The glistening neon signs and vibrant colors paint a lively atmosphere. It's a warm and humid summer evening following a sudden afternoon rain shower. The damp ground reflects the colorful lights around.

Characters:
- Mei Ling: 24-year-old woman with a slender build, medium-height, shoulder-length wavy black hair, and brown eyes. She is wearing a pastel pink short-sleeve blouse with ruffles, a knee-length floral skirt that has shades of pink, yellow, and white flowers, as well as a pair of pale pink kitten heels. She is carrying a blush pink purse with a gold chain.

- Lily: 26-year-old woman, slightly taller than Mei Ling. She has straight black hair in a neat low ponytail, and dark brown eyes that seem to smile. She is wearing a light green short-sleeve blouse adorned with small white polka dots and an ivory pleated midi-skirt. She completes the outfit with white strappy high-heel sandals and a small beige wicker handbag.

- Cherry: 28-year-old woman with shoulder-length curly dark hair tied in a loose high-ponytail with a red scrunchie, and deep-set blue eyes. She has a slight limp from a previous injury. She is wearing a short-sleeve red checkered dress that ends just above her knees with thick black belt, black stockings, and black ballet flats. She is carrying a small black purse.

INT. NIGHT MARKET – NIGHT

MEI LING and LILY are walking through the night market, laughing at the garish clothes they bought from a street vendor. They pass some food stalls, and Mei Ling points to a stall selling spicy noodles.

MEI LING
(Pointing at noodle stall)
This noodle stall is famous for its super spicy noodles! Let's get some!

LILY
(Smiling)
Good idea! Let's call Cherry to join us.

Mei Ling dials Cherry's phone number on the payphone and waits for the response. Cherry appears from around the corner, limping a bit.

CHERRY
(Excitedly)
You wouldn't believe it! The last store I went to had the cutest shoes!

Cherry joins Mei Ling and Lily as they order their noodles from the food stall. They find an open table nearby and sit down.

INT. NIGHT MARKET TABLE - NIGHT

The friends chat and laugh, enjoying their steaming bowls of spicy noodles. Abruptly, Mei Ling puts down her chopsticks and subtly crosses her legs, trying to hide her discomfort.

LILY
(Noticing Mei Ling)
Everything ok, Mei?

MEI LING
(Slightly distressed, trying to smile)
Yeah, I just need to find a restroom soon. These spicy noodles, you know?

CHERRY
(Unhelpful)
The restrooms are pretty far from here, Mei.

Mei Ling starts squirming in her seat, eyes darting frantically around the market. She gets more uncomfortable and desperate by the second. Her face reddens in agony, sweat starts forming on her brow, indicating her attempt to hold her bowels.

A sudden commotion in the market draws their attention. A street performer starts a fire-breathing show nearby, attracting a sizable crowd. Mei Ling, seeing the perfect opportunity to act, seizes the moment as onlookers are captivated by the performance. She straightens her legs, leans to one side with a clenched jaw, and lets out a long, deep exhale.

The camera angle shifts to focus on Mei Ling's face, portraying a mix of pain and relief, as she discreetly releases her bowels amidst the smoky, aromatic chaos of the market. Her pastel pink heeled shoes sparkle under the neon lights and her purse appears even more radiant. 

As Mei Ling finishes her inescapable act, she silently consoles herself with the fact that she managed to maintain her discretion. A sweet, metallic scent begins to mingle with the smells of the market, caused by the occurrence of her unavoidable predicament.

A nearby vendor selling durian notices the smell and starts to frown, muting the chaos around her for a moment. She glances over at Mei Ling with suspicion, then looks away, dismissing her thoughts.

LILY
(Turning to Mei Ling, whispering)
Did you...?

MEI LING
(Quietly, almost whimpering)
I had no choice. No one seemed to notice, and I couldn't hold it any longer. What should I do now?

LILY
(Conspiratorial)
Wait for the fire-breathing show to end, then we'll escort you quickly to a nearby store, pretend we're shopping for new clothes, and we'll help you get cleaned up in their restroom. 

CHERRY
(Nods in agreement)
We'll get through this together, Mei.

The friends wait for the performance to end, the applause offers the perfect cover to make their escape. With Mei Ling in the middle, Lily and Cherry link arms with her and quickly lead her to a nearby textile store offering an abundance of colorful, patterned clothes.

In the end, despite the troublesome situation, Mei Ling and her friends manage to find a humorous, relatable side to their experience, which only serves to strengthen the bond between the three dynamic women. The market adventure remains a memorable story, one that they will recount in whispers in future catch-ups, and cannot help but elicit giggles and rolling eyes. Unforgettable.

波函数在PCG的应用

PCG是一种用于解线性方程组的算法，可以用于求解包含波函数的薛定谔方程。

具体地说，我们可以将薛定谔方程表示为一个线性方程组，其中未知数是波函数各个节点的值。然后，我们可以使用PCG算法来求解这个线性方程组，从而得到波函数的近似解。

PCG算法具有快速收敛、内存占用少等优点，在求解大规模的薛定谔方程时非常有用。同时，由于波函数具有实数部分和虚数部分，所以在使用PCG算法时需要对其进行变形，从而保证算法的有效性。

总之，PCG算法是求解波函数的一种有效手段，能够提高计算效率、减少内存占用，是理论计算物理学等领域中常用的工具之一。

Calculate the pH of a solution prepared by adding 15.0mL of a 0.500M H₂SO, to 35.0mL of 0.750 NaOH. (4 marks)

To calculate the pH of the resulting solution, we first need to determine the number of moles of H⁺ and OH⁻ ions in the solutions before mixing.

Number of moles of H₂SO₄ = 0.015 L × 0.500 mol/L = 0.0075 mol

H₂SO₄ also releases two H⁺ ions, so we need to double this value:

Number of moles of H⁺ = 0.0075 mol × 2 = 0.015 mol

Number of moles of NaOH = 0.035 L × 0.750 mol/L = 0.02625 mol

Next, we determine the limiting reactant and the amount of excess ions left in the solution.

0.015 mol H⁺ and 0.02625 mol OH⁻ will react, producing 0.015 mol of H₂O, and leaving 0.01125 mol OH⁻ ions in excess:

0.02625 mol OH⁻ - 0.015 mol H⁺ = 0.01125 mol OH⁻

Now we find the concentration of OH⁻ ions remaining in the solution after the reaction:

OH⁻ concentration = 0.01125 mol / (0.015 L + 0.035 L) = 0.225 mol/L

To find the resulting pH, we can use the formula:

pOH = -log10([OH⁻])

pOH = -log10(0.225) ≈ 0.65

Finally, we use the relationship between pH and pOH:

pH = 14 - pOH

pH = 14 - 0.65 ≈ 13.35

The resulting pH of the solution is approximately 13.35.


vertical coupling and lateral coupling in ring resonator, which one create high sensitivity in refractive index change?

Vertical coupling in a ring resonator typically creates higher sensitivity to refractive index changes compared to lateral coupling. This is because the evanescent field extending from the waveguide in the vertical direction interacts more strongly with the surrounding medium, providing better sensitivity to changes in the refractive index. On the other hand, lateral coupling relies on the interaction between the evanescent fields of two waveguides placed side by side, and its sensitivity to refractive index changes is generally lower than that of vertical coupling.

To what extent does the presentation of the theme of guilt transform character relationships in ‘Crime and Punishment’ and ‘Beloved’

In both Fyodor Dostoevsky's 'Crime and Punishment' and Toni Morrison's 'Beloved', the presentation of the theme of guilt significantly transforms character relationships, driving the narratives and shaping the psychological and emotional development of characters. The portrayal of guilt in these literary works drastically influences interpersonal relationships, pushes characters to confront their past, and impacts their connections to the society in which they live.

In 'Crime and Punishment', the main character Raskolnikov suffers extreme guilt after committing a double murder, which puts his relationships with others, particularly his sister (Dunya), his mother (Pulkheria), and his friend (Razumikhin) at great risk. He is tormented by his guilt, which isolates him and causes him to become increasingly introspective. Raskolnikov is constantly at odds with his conscience, and the guilt of his crime causes him to lash out against those close to him, distancing himself further as he fears that they will discover his crime. His character relationships are molded by this guilt, and the reader slowly realizes that his actions are largely driven by his desire to run away from or atone for the murders he committed.

Similarly, guilt also plays a significant role in transforming character relationships in 'Beloved'. The protagonist Sethe is plagued by guilt over the infanticide she committed when attempting to save her daughter from slavery. This guilt influences her relationship with her surviving daughter, Denver, who suffers from her mother's emotional withdrawal and her inability to connect or express love to her, due to her guilt. Guilt also shapes Sethe's relationship with her resurrected daughter, Beloved, as she desperately tries to justify her actions to the ghostly presence, seeking forgiveness and redemption.

In both stories, the burden of guilt impacts not only family and friend relationships but also those with their respective love interests: Raskolnikov with Sonya and Sethe with Paul D. In both instances, the characters' guilt results in a strained connection as they are consumed by their past actions. Sonya serves as Raskolnikov's ultimate source of redemption as she encourages him to confess and face the consequences of his actions. Meanwhile, Sethe's relationship with Paul D is tumultuous and rocky, primarily because her guilt and shame make it challenging for her to trust and love again.

Additionally, guilt profoundly influences the characters' links to the societies in which they live, pushing them towards solitude and introspection. Raskolnikov's guilt leads him to face societal retribution in the form of imprisonment, while Sethe experiences her own type of social isolation and ostracism from her community due to her past.

Both novels ultimately deal with their respective characters facing their guilt and making an attempt at atonement for their transgressions. Through this process, their relationships with others are significantly transformed. In 'Crime and Punishment', Raskolnikov's confession allows for a new beginning for him and his loved ones, rebuilding and strengthening the relationships that his guilt had destroyed. Meanwhile, in 'Beloved', the characters gradually confront their guilt and attempt to move forward with their lives following their experiences of trauma, forgiveness, and acceptance.

In conclusion, the presentation of the theme of guilt critically transforms character relationships in both 'Crime and Punishment' and 'Beloved.' This theme drives the narratives, shapes character development, and primarily impacts the connections between the characters and the societies they inhabit. Through the process of confronting their guilt and seeking redemption, the characters in both novels find new beginnings and altered dynamics within the relationships that they hold dear.

以下是使用FFmpeg进行播放的一般步骤：

1. 首先，我们需要将GB28181协议的PS视频流转换为RTMP或RTSP协议的流。这可以通过第三方工具（如ZLMediaKit、EasyDarwin等）来实现。

2. 配置并运行转换工具，使其将GB28181的PS视频流转换为RTMP或RTSP协议的流，并获取转换后的流媒体地址。

3. 安装FFmpeg。在Linux操作系统下，可以使用包管理器来安装FFmpeg，例如在Ubuntu上：
```
sudo apt update
sudo apt install ffmpeg
```

在Windows和macOS上，可以从官网（`https://www.ffmpeg.org/download.html`）下载预编译的二进制文件。

4. 使用FFmpeg的`ffplay`工具播放转换后的流。在命令行中运行以下命令：
```
ffplay -i <rtmp_or_rtsp_url>
```

将`<rtmp_or_rtsp_url>`替换为步骤2中获取的RTMP或RTSP流地址。

例如，如果转换后的流地址为`rtmp://localhost:1935/live/stream`，则运行如下命令：
```
ffplay -i rtmp://localhost:1935/live/stream
```

这将使用FFmpeg的ffplay工具播放RTMP或RTSP协议的视频流。

To update the WSL kernel on your machine, you will need to perform the following steps.

1. Open your Windows Terminal (or Command Prompt) with administrator privileges. To do this, press the Windows key, type "cmd" or "Windows Terminal", right-click on the application, and select "Run as administrator."

2. Make sure you have WSL 2 installed on your system. To check if you already have the WSL 2, run the following command:

```
wsl -l -v
```

If you see "WSL 2" under the "Version" column, you are good to go. If not, please follow the official Microsoft guide to install the WSL 2: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/install

3. Once you have WSL 2 installed, run the following command to update the WSL kernel:

```
wsl --update
```

4. Wait for the update to complete. The terminal will display a message when the update is successful.

5. After the update completes, restart the WSL by running the following command:

```
wsl --shutdown
```

6. Now, start the WSL again using the following command:

```
wsl
```

7. The WSL kernel should now be updated.

If you still face any issues and the error persists, consider reinstalling the WSL kernel from the official Microsoft page: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/install-manual.

Once you've updated the WSL kernel, Docker Desktop should no longer give you the error about requiring a newer WSL kernel version. You can now start using Docker with WSL 2 for your development needs.

In an article in the journal Health and Place, Hui and Bell found that among 2428 boys ages 7 to 12 years, 461 were overweight or obese. On the basis of this study, can we conclude that more than 15 percent of the boys ages 7 to 12 in the sampled population are obese or overweight? Let alpha=0.05. What is the appropriate testing method for this data?

To determine whether more than 15 percent of the boys ages 7 to 12 in the sampled population are obese or overweight, we can perform a one-sample proportion hypothesis test. The null hypothesis is that the proportion of overweight or obese boys is equal to 15 percent (p = 0.15), and the alternative hypothesis is that the proportion is greater than 15 percent (p > 0.15). Since the given significance level is alpha=0.05, we will use a z-test to test the hypothesis.

Here's the information from the study:

- Sample size (n) = 2428
- Number of overweight or obese boys (x) = 461
- Proportion of overweight or obese boys in sample (p̂) = x/n = 461/2428 = 0.1897

Now let's compute the z-score for p̂:

z = (p̂ - p) / sqrt(p(1-p) / n)
z = (0.1897 - 0.15) / sqrt(0.15(1-0.15) / 2428)
z ≈ 5.92

Now we will compare the z-score to the critical value for an alpha=0.05 level test:

- For a one-tailed test with alpha=0.05, the critical z-value is 1.645.

Since the z-score (5.92) is greater than the critical value (1.645), we reject the null hypothesis. This indicates that there is evidence to support the alternative hypothesis, so we can conclude that more than 15 percent of the boys ages 7 to 12 in the sampled population are obese or overweight.

for this NIST CSF category ID.AM-1: Physical devices and systems within the organization are inventoried, what could be the threats and vulnerabilities ?

1. Unauthorized access to physical devices and systems: Unauthorized individuals may gain access to sensitive devices or systems, increasing the risk of data theft, tampering, or manipulation.

2. Inaccurate inventory records: Incomplete or inaccurate inventories can lead to gaps in security controls or poor management of devices, increasing the risk of vulnerabilities being exploited.

3. Unauthorized hardware and software installation: Unauthorized devices or software may be installed on the organization's systems, potentially leading to security breaches, data loss, or malware infections.

4. Device theft or loss: The risk of physical devices being lost or stolen, which may expose sensitive data or allow unauthorized access to systems.

5. Disposal of devices: Devices that are not securely disposed of can cause data to be leaked or lead to the risk of an attacker reusing the hardware.

6. Inadequate physical security measures: Poor physical security controls can increase vulnerabilities, such as unauthorized access, tampering with devices, or exposure to environmental threats.

7. Unpatched or outdated software: Outdated software can introduce security vulnerabilities that may be exploited by malicious actors.

8. Inadequate asset decommissioning: Failure to properly decommission or retire assets can lead to unauthorized access or additional vulnerabilities.

9. Insider threats: Employees or contractors with access to physical devices and systems may exploit vulnerabilities or compromise security from within the organization.

10. Supply chain risks: Vulnerabilities or compromise in the supply chain may result in insecure devices, hardware or software being introduced into the organization's systems, increasing the risk of security breaches.

To minimize these threats and vulnerabilities, organizations must maintain an up-to-date, comprehensive inventory of physical devices and systems, ensure proper access controls and physical security measures are in place, and continuously monitor and manage the lifecycle of assets.

如何看书

要想看书，请按照以下步骤操作：

1. 选择一本书：首先从书架、图书馆、书店或其他地方挑选您感兴趣的书籍。找到一个您感兴趣的主题或一个您想进一步了解的专业领域的书籍，以保证您在阅读过程中保持兴趣。

2. 找一个舒适的环境：选择一个安静、舒适的地方阅读。确保您有足够的光线，一个舒适的座位，以及在需要时可以休息的地方。

3. 预览书的内容：在开始阅读之前，简要浏览一下书的封面、封底、目录和索引。这样可以帮助您了解书籍的基本结构和内容。

4. 开始阅读：从第一章或序言开始阅读。尝试阅读每个段落，以便对内容有基本的理解。如果遇到不理解的词汇或概念，可以查阅字典或互联网以便更好地理解。

5. 保持专注：将手机、电子设备等潜在干扰源放在一边，让自己全身心沉浸在书中。如果注意力容易分散，尝试分段阅读和设定阅读目标，以提高专注力。

6. 做笔记和记录：在阅读过程中，如果发现了有趣的观点、信息或想法，可以在书本上做标记，或使用笔记本记录下来。这有助于您在阅读结束后回顾书中的重点内容。

7. 思考和消化：在阅读过程中，花时间思考作者的观点，评价其观点的有效性，以及看看这些观点如何与您的经验和知识产生共鸣。这样有助于加深对内容的理解。

8. 与他人讨论：与朋友、家人或同事分享您在阅读中的所得。讨论书籍中的观点可以增强理解和记忆，并可能引发有趣的对话和辩论。

9. 阅读其他相关书籍：如果您对一个主题或领域产生浓厚兴趣，可以考虑阅读更多相关书籍，以更深入地了解该主题。

10. 保持阅读的习惯：阅读应该是一种持续的习惯，而不仅仅是一次性的活动。为了不断扩大知识面和提高思维能力，请持续阅读不同主题的书籍。
напиши подробно о Сравнение результатов тестирования с изначальными значениями. Приведи данные исследования

Сравнение результатов тестирования с изначальными значениями является важной частью процесса тестирования и помогает оценить эффективность применяемых изменений. В данной статье мы рассмотрим, какие данные могут быть использованы для сравнения результатов тестирования с изначальными значениями.

Данные исследования

Для исследования будем использовать пример контрольного тестирования для сайта интернет-магазина. Рассмотрим две группы пользователей: группу А, которой показывается старая версия сайта, и группу Б, которой показывается новая версия сайта. Каждый пользователь переходит на сайт, выбирает товар и оформляет заказ. Мы собираем следующие данные:

- Число пользователей, сделавших заказ в группе А: 100 из 1000 (10%)
- Число пользователей, сделавших заказ в группе Б: 120 из 1000 (12%)
- Средний чек в группе А: 50 долларов
- Средний чек в группе Б: 60 долларов

Сравнение результатов тестирования

Чтобы оценить результаты тестирования, необходимо сравнить метрики контрольной группы А со значением этой же метрики в экспериментальной группе Б. В представленном примере мы сравниваем две метрики: долю пользователей, сделавших заказ, и средний чек. Для каждой метрики сравним два показателя: абсолютное значение в контрольной группе А и в экспериментальной группе Б, и отношение показателя в группе Б к показателю в группе А.

1. Доля пользователей, сделавших заказ:

- Группа А: 100/1000 = 10%
- Группа Б: 120/1000 = 12%
- Отношение группы Б к группе А: 12%/10% = 1,2

Результаты показывают, что доля пользователей, сделавших заказ, увеличилась на 20% в группе Б по сравнению с группой А.

2. Средний чек:

- Группа А: 50 долларов
- Группа Б: 60 долларов
- Отношение группы Б к группе А: 60/50 = 1,2

Результаты показывают, что средний чек вырос на 20% в группе Б по сравнению с группой А.

Выводы

Сравнение результатов тестирования с изначальными значениями позволяет оценить эффективность изменений в интерфейсе сайта. В представленном исследовании мы сравнивали долю пользователей, сделавших заказ, и средний чек в группах А и Б. Результаты показали, что эти метрики увеличились на 20% в группе Б по сравнению с группой А. Это свидетельствует о том, что новый дизайн сайта более привлекателен для пользователей и позволяет увеличить объем продаж.

She was his cousin, but they had grown close over the years, and he felt a deep connection to her. He wondered if she felt the same way. It was the power to shift into a wolf, a gift that had been passed down through generations of his family. Suddenly, he was no longer standing on the wall. He was running through the forest, the wind in his fur, the scent of the trees filling his nostrils. He felt alive, powerful, free. But as soon as the feeling came, it was gone. He was back on the wall, in his human form once again. He knew that he needed to learn more about this strange gift, but for now, he had more pressing matters to attend to. The truth about his parentage could change everything, and he had to be careful. With a heavy heart, Jon made his way back down into Winterfell, ready to face whatever lay ahead.

As Jon descended the stairs, he mentally prepared himself for the conversation he was about to have with Sansa. He didn't know how she would react, but he hoped she would understand that he wasn't intentionally keeping secrets from her. Jon had only found out about his true parentage recently, and it had been a shock to him. Yet, knowing who he truly was didn't change the bond that he and Sansa shared.

When Jon entered the room where Sansa was sitting, engrossed in some documents, he took a deep breath, willing himself to be calm and honest with her. He approached her, and her usually serious and focused face broke into a smile. The sight of her smiling face was both heartening and heartbreaking. He didn't want to cause her pain, but he knew the truth needed to be shared.

"Sansa," Jon began, "there's something important I need to tell you." He hesitated for a moment, trying to find the right words. Sensing his discomfort and concern, Sansa laid down the documents and looked up at him. "Is everything alright, Jon?" she asked, a hint of worry in her voice.

He sighed, knowing he couldn't stall any longer. "I've recently discovered the truth about my parentage," he said, his voice low and filled with a mixture of emotions. "I'm not actually your half-brother, but your cousin. My mother was Lyanna Stark, and my father was Rhaegar Targaryen."

Finally, she managed to say, "I... I always knew there was something different about you, Jon. But I never thought... how did you find out?"

Jon told her the story of how he had uncovered the secret hidden for decades: the Tower of Joy, the tragic love story, the promise made by their uncle Ned Stark. Sansa listened intently, her face a mixture of astonishment and sadness.

When Jon was done speaking, they sat in silence for a while, letting the weight of the revelation sink in. Sansa finally broke the silence. "I'm not entirely sure how to feel about this," she admitted. "It changes so much. But no matter what blood runs through your veins, Jon, you are still family to me."

Jon felt his heart swell with gratitude and love for his cousin. "Thank you, Sansa," he said, his voice thick with emotion. "That means more to me than you know."

可行性分析报告

可行性分析报告是一份详细的研究报告，旨在评估某个项目、产品或者服务实施的可行性和可能性。它主要评估项目在技术、市场、经济、环境影响以及法律法规等方面的现实可行性。可行性分析报告可以帮助决策者在投入资源和承担风险之前理解项目的各种层面，从而做出明智的决策。以下是一个可行性分析报告的基本结构和内容。

1. 项目背景和介绍

在这一部分，需要详细描述项目的背景信息、项目目标以及项目的主要创新点和亮点。这有助于了解项目的起源和动机。

2. 市场分析

市场分析主要评估项目的市场需求和竞争态势。这包括对目标市场的大小、需求趋势、客户群体、竞争对手分析以及可能的市场机会和风险的全面了解。

3. 技术可行性分析

这一部分主要研究项目的技术成熟度、实施难度以及可能遇到的技术挑战。需要确保项目选择的技术方案是可行的、可靠的，并能满足项目目标。

4. 经济可行性分析

经济可行性分析主要评估项目的成本和收益。这包括项目的投资预算、资金来源、运营成本、收益预测以及项目的投资回报率。此外，还需要对项目的财务风险进行评估，并提出相应的风险应对措施。

5. 环境影响和社会效益分析

在这一部分，需要分析项目实施对环境和社会的潜在影响，以确保项目在满足经济效益的同时不会对环境和社会造成不良后果。同时，也要分析项目可能带来的积极影响，如提高就业机会、促进地区经济发展等。

6. 法律法规和政策分析

法律法规和政策分析主要评估项目是否符合相关法规政策要求，以及项目如何在法律法规框架内顺利推进。这包括项目的合规性、许可证和批文等方面的内容。

7. 项目实施计划及风险分析

在这一部分，需要详细描述项目从启动到完成的实施计划，包括项目的关键阶段、里程碑、责任分配等。此外，还需要对项目可能遇到的风险进行全面分析，并提出相应的风险应对措施。

8. 结论

基于以上分析，总结项目的可行性，并给出明确的建议。如果项目可行性较高，可以提出具体的建议和措施；如果项目可行性较低，可以提出改进措施或者建议暂缓实施。

Man's perspective:

He was rambling across the wooded path, the sun piercing the canopy in scattered spots, making the entire path feel like some vast, terrestrial chessboard. The invigorating scent of the damp forest permeated his senses; it had just rained the night before, but walking on this path was familiar territory.

Suddenly, a quiet rustling caught his attention from his reverie. That's when he spotted her—the woman who was about to collide with his life. She stood by the edge of the path, trying to pick some elusive berries with nimble fingers. Her fiery-red hair danced in the fragile sunlight. A flame birthed in the wildwood, he thought.

"What brings you to these parts of the woods?" he called out to her, hiding his immediate intrigue.

She looked up, her wide eyes meeting his. "Oh, hello. I come here to forage sometimes. And you?" she asked, a hint of curiosity lingering in her voice.

"Just stretching my legs and exploring what nature has to offer," he replied, smirking. He could already sense she was someone he wanted to know more about. The pull of the unknown, and the possibilities it could bring, was difficult to resist.

"Say, do you need some help with those berries?" he suggested, never one to shy away from lending a hand, especially if it meant getting closer to this wild-haired beauty.

"Yes, can you help me with that cluster just above my reach?" she responded. He could see her eyes twinkle with gratitude.

As he reached out to pluck the berries from the stubborn vines, he couldn't help but feel alive as their hands brushed against one another. Perhaps their collision wasn't mere happenstance; the raw, magnetic energy of the encounter was palpable. The wilderness was unpredictable, and questions of chance and fate swirled through his mind.

They continued their amble along the path, the woods urging them on with a coy, knowing energy. The day was young, and a shared adventure along these verdant trails beckoned.

Woman's perspective:

Warm sunlight dappled the forest floor, a soothing palette of green hues. There she was, quietly plucking handfuls of ripe berries, filling her wicker basket in hopes they would bring joy to her loved ones when taken home.

She shifted her focus to the highest-reaching cluster, stretching her arm in a futile effort to pick the tantalizingly red berries. That's when she sensed his presence.

"Oh, hello. I come here to forage sometimes. And you?" She inquired as to his reasons for passing through this particularly secluded part of the woods, feeling her heart flutter.

His eyes held a familiar curiosity, and she wondered if he felt the same spark of connection she did. "Just stretching my legs and exploring what nature has to offer," he responded, his confident stance inviting and warm, like a strong oak in the midst of the saplings surrounding them.

"Say, do you need some help with those berries?" he offered, an act of kindness she wasn't expecting from a stranger but was grateful for nonetheless.

"Yes, can you help me with that cluster just above my reach?" she asked, hoping to prolong their exchange.

As he procured the berries, she couldn't help but lose herself in the consideration of this serendipitous encounter. The way their hands brushed together sent a shiver down her spine, like a whisper from the wind, intertwining them into one.

"Thank you," she breathed, as they began to amble along the path, exchanging stories and laughter, their feet treading a tapestry of delicate ferns and fallen leaves. What once was an ordinary day spent foraging in the forest was now tinted with the blush of newfound connection.

The sunken moon bathed the quiet town of Draighford in a silvery haze, the wind carrying whispers of the lost souls that lingered in the night. White Strand Inn, a colonial relic perched alongside the river, emanated an eerie glow – a lighthouse of lost souls.

Mary O'Mara stepped from the rain-soaked stone pathway into the dimly lit tavern, her emerald eyes filled with a combination of trepidation and anticipation. Several heads turned in her direction before resuming their melancholic conversations.

"Isn't it eerie?" Mary asked, just loud enough for the barman, a balding rotund man by the name of Patrick, to hear her.

"They say the ghosts of the old families still haunt these parts," Patrick replied, trying to mask his discomfort.

Mary's eyes danced around the room, half expecting to see a phantom hovering behind her. "Could you point me in the direction of Mister Frederick O'Donnell?" she inquired.

"Ah, rumor travels fast," he sighed. "Aye, he's in the back corner, shrouded in darkness. Be careful, lass. That man offers naught but despair and danger."

As Mary made her way towards the mysterious figure, the tavern briefly fell silent, a momentary requiem for the choices she was about to make. Frederick O'Donnell studied her approach, his brooding eyes never straying from beneath his shadowy hat.

"I'm told you have a tale to share, Mister O'Donnell," Mary ventured as she took a seat, her tone suggesting a demand rather than a request.

O'Donnell lowered his gaze, studying the glass of whiskey in front of him. "I do," he muttered. "But the question is, are you ready to bear the weight of this truth?"

Her gaze locked with his, and she gave a firm nod.

"Very well," he began, shifting uncomfortably in his seat. "What I'm about to tell you is the darkest secret that's been buried in the depths of Draighford for centuries. The one responsible for the curse that has plagued this town."

Uncertainty filled Mary's eyes, but she didn't dare look away.

"A century ago, there lived a woman by the name of Isabella Croft – her beauty, legend said, only matched by her sadistic nature. In her treacherous ways, she became the embodiment of the malevolent spirit that consumed this town."

"But how, what did she do?" Mary asked, unable to keep the quiver out of her voice.

"Feeding on the despair of those who wandered into her path, Isabella devised a ghastly method of drawing their lives out, one weakened breath at a time."

Mary felt the air grow colder, a spectral presence bearing witness to the tale being told.

"She would seduce the lost souls who dared to step foot into her lair. Her most intoxicating feature? Her legs, said to be as powerful as they were alluring. At the moment of intimacy, she would trap these souls within her scissor-like embrace, squeezing the life out of them."

Frederick shuddered, a beads of sweat forming on his forehead as he continued.

“As heartbeats slowed, she would slowly tighten her embrace, suffocating them with her silk-covered thighs until unconsciousness consumed their helpless existence."

Mary gasped, her grip on the table becoming white-knuckled. "And still she walks these steps among us?"

"Aye," Frederick confirmed, his voice barely audible. "Her spirit dwells in these cursed corners, waiting to ensnare her next victim."

A chill ran down Mary's spine as she wrestled with the horrors she had just heard. With a nod, she excused herself from the table, leaving Frederick alone once more.

As the door to the White Strand Inn swung shut behind her, the walls of the building seemed to sigh with relief. The spectral energy dissipated, once again, lying in wait for the next unfortunate soul to awaken it from its restless slumber.

What are spherical roller bearings and where are they used?

Spherical roller bearings are a type of rolling element bearing that can accommodate both radial and axial loads in both directions. They feature two rows of symmetrical barrel-shaped rollers that run on a common spherical outer raceway, allowing them to compensate for shaft misalignment and reduce friction.

Spherical roller bearings are commonly used in heavy-duty applications, such as mining equipment, construction machinery, wind turbines, industrial gearboxes, and paper mills, where high radial and axial loads, shock loads, and vibrations are present. They are also used in automotive applications, such as wheel hub assemblies and transmissions.

create BCG divisions for dell

BCG (Boston Consulting Group) matrix is a strategic tool that helps companies to assess their portfolio of products or business units. It is an analytical approach that categorizes a company's products or services into four categories: dogs, cash cows, question marks (also known as problem children), and stars. Here are the BCG divisions for Dell:

1. Dogs: This category includes products that have a low market share and low growth rate. For Dell, this could include old and outdated products that are no longer in demand or have been replaced by newer and better products.

2. Cash Cows: This category includes products that have a high market share and low growth rate. For Dell, this could include their laptops and desktops which have a strong market demand but are not rapidly growing.

3. Question Marks: This category includes products that have a low market share but a high growth rate. For Dell, this could include their gaming laptops, virtual reality headsets, and other emerging technologies that have the potential to become a future star product.

4. Stars: This category includes products that have a high market share and a high growth rate. For Dell, this could include their servers and storage solutions, which are rapidly growing and have a strong market demand.

"This is <PRESIDIO_ANONYMIZED_PERSON>," said the man sitting across the table, the dim light illuminating his cold gray eyes.

"Who?" John Wick was momentarily caught off guard.

Alexander smiled. "Thorn, like the one that gives sharp pain when embedded, like the scar it leaves behind."

It had been a week since John sought solace in the anonymity of New York after Rome's blood-soaked mess. The High Table was not pleased. It seemed John had stumbled onto a hidden part of the underworld, one that had quietly slipped through the cracks. Thorn had invited John to a lavish penthouse suite in The Continental.

He was not one to mince words. "I hear you've been quite busy, Mr. Wick. I must say, I am… intrigued. I think we could help each other."

"How so?" John asked, his voice low and wary.

"I have a problem that requires someone with your… skill set. And I understand that you have a problem with the High Table. I have connections, Mr. Wick. And these connections may be of use to you."

Intrigued yet suspicious, John leaned forward. "Continue."

Thorn described a woman, Evelyn Frost, who ran an elite group of assassins. She was untouchable, and she posed a direct threat to his interests. John would eliminate her. In return, Thorn would assist John in navigating the murky depths of assassins after him.

*  *  *

That night, John found himself perched on the rooftop of a nearby building, surveying a luxurious, isolated mansion at the outskirts of the city. Evelyn's fortress was surrounded by her loyal enforcers. John knew he had to devise an unexpected entrance, to come at her from a place she would never suspect.

He had found it. It wasn't long before John was riding his motorcycle inside the dark and winding storm drain beneath the mansion. He crouched low to avoid the pipes and debris hanging from the ceiling, speeding invisible beneath the world above.

With a cautious eye, John infiltrated the mansion. He swiftly dispatched a few of her guards, disposing of them silently. He could feel it; he was on the hunt once more.

He finally found Evelyn in a dimly lit, opulent room. She was a tall, elegant woman, her hair falling in soft waves down her shoulders. Despite the evident danger, she looked utterly relaxed, lounging in a luxurious velvet chair. She noticed John out of the corner of her eye.

"Ah, the infamous John Wick. At last, you've graced me with your presence. I've been expecting you."

John frowned. "You know why I'm here. This is between you and Thorn. Leave the High Table out of it."

Evelyn laughed. "You really think you can negotiate with me like that?" She stood up, revealing that she was taller than he had initially thought, with lean, muscular legs.

Immediately, she rushed towards him, swinging a leg out in a powerful roundhouse kick aimed at his head. He managed to block it, but barely. They exchanged blows, fists and kicks flying, each narrowly escaping the other's grasp.

Suddenly, Evelyn lunged forward, locking her thighs around John's neck in a tight grip. She asked, "Do you know how many men I've killed with these thighs, Mr. Wick?"

He struggled to free himself, choking and coughing. She had him in a headscissor hold that was building pressure on his carotid arteries, restricting blood flow to his brain. He could feel himself sinking into a dark void, panic rising as his vision clouded.

Backed into a corner, John marshaled the last remnants of his strength. He reached beneath his jacket, using his free arm to pull out a serrated knife. Slashing at the fleshy inner thigh, he drew blood, which flowed, warm and wet, against his face. It was enough to cause her to loosen the grip. 

He gasped for air; Evelyn staggered, clutching her wound. Seizing the moment, he delivered a powerful kick that sent her into the wall, where she crumpled.

Breathing heavily, John hovered over her. "This is for Thorn.”

Evelyn, unable to speak, glowered at him. He lowered his gun, aiming it at her head, then hesitating at her fearlessness. Instead, John gave her a chance, sparing her life. He'd eliminated the threat and refused to be a pawn.

Alexander was furious at John's decision, but the High Table still had questions for Evelyn. John was given a chance to hunt a new target within the High Table’s interests. And just like that, he submerged again into the shadowy world that would forever have its grip on his life.

Как через boto3 в Python выполнить команду CloudFormation Web console?

В CloudFormation Web console доступны различные функции по управлению стеками и ресурсами. Часть из них можно выполнить через boto3 в Python с помощью вызовов API. 

Например, чтобы создать новый стек в CloudFormation, можно использовать метод `create_stack`. Пример кода:

```python
import boto3

cf_client = boto3.client('cloudformation')

stack_name = 'my_stack_name'
template_url = 'https://mybucket.s3.amazonaws.com/my_template.yaml'

response = cf_client.create_stack(
    StackName=stack_name,
    TemplateURL=template_url,
    # Другие параметры можно установить здесь, например, параметры стека
)

print(response)
```

Аналогично, чтобы удалить стек, можно использовать метод `delete_stack`. Пример кода:

```python
import boto3

cf_client = boto3.client('cloudformation')

stack_name = 'my_stack_name'

response = cf_client.delete_stack(
    StackName=stack_name,
    # Другие параметры можно установить здесь, например, параметры удаления стека
)

print(response)
```

Более подробную информацию о методах API CloudFormation можно найти в официальной документации AWS: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudformation/index.html.

Explain how exposed is China to globalization, and what have been the political, economic, technological, social, environmental, or other impacts of the globalization trend on your country, highlighting both negative or positive impacts.

China has become highly exposed to globalization since its economic reforms began in the 1970s. As the world's second-largest economy, the globalization of China has had significant political, economic, technological, social, and environmental impacts, both positive and negative.

Positive impacts:
1) Economic growth: The opening of China's market to global trade and investment has led to rapid economic growth. The annual GDP growth rate since the early 1980s has averaged around 9.5%, lifting millions of people out of poverty and turning China into a global economic powerhouse.

2) Technological advancement: The influx of foreign direct investment (FDI) and multinational corporations has provided China with access to cutting-edge technologies and management practices, promoting technological innovation and productivity in various sectors.

3) Infrastructure development: China's expanding involvement in global trade has facilitated significant investment in infrastructure projects, such as modern highways, airports, high-speed railways, and telecommunication networks. This advanced infrastructure has become a key driver of growth and competitiveness for the country.

4) Cultural exchange: The rise of tourism, education, and cultural exchanges due to globalization has increased the exposure of Chinese people to diverse cultures and ideas, fostering a more global outlook and cultural understanding among the population.

Negative impacts:
1) Income inequality: While globalization has helped to lift millions of people out of poverty, it has also contributed to widening income inequality in China. The wealthy coastal regions have benefited the most from globalization, while poorer inland areas have lagged behind, creating a growing income gap between rich and poor populations.

2) Environmental degradation: Due to rapid industrialization and urbanization, China has faced significant environmental challenges. Air pollution, soil contamination, and water scarcity have become pressing issues, affecting public health and causing long-term consequences for the country's development.

3) Loss of cultural identity: Critics argue that the influence of foreign cultures, products, and media has led to a dilution of traditional Chinese culture and values, undermining the country's cultural heritage and fostering a more westernized orientation among the younger generations.

4) Political challenges: China's rise as a global power has also led to tensions with other countries. Concerns over trade imbalances, intellectual property theft, and territorial disputes have strained China's relationships with the United States and other countries, potentially affecting its long-term political stability and global standing.

In conclusion, globalization has had significant impacts on China, both positive and negative. While economic growth, technological advancement, and infrastructure development have been clear benefits, the challenges of income inequality, environmental degradation, cultural dilution, and international political tensions cannot be neglected. As the country continues to be exposed to globalization, it will need to address these issues while maximizing the benefits of global economic integration.

The nurse smelled of antiseptic and baby powder as she leaned over to tend the wound. She looked at her with careworn eyes and delicately ran the needle through Zoey's iodine-stained hand. "That's a dear. We'll have you stitched up in no time."
The seventeen stitches took less than an hour. Zoey's manager, Maurice, waited the whole time and was still waiting as Zoey emerged.
Maurice drove Zoey back to her apartment, the sec-and story of one of Southside's many townhouses. Large and leering, Maurice prattled the whole way, "My dear, you must be careful. I know how sharp you keep those knives. Very good for the kitchen, but so quick to cut if a hand slips but a little. You take some time to recover. We will see you in a few days, after those stitches come out." Feeling light-headed, Zoey simply watched as the scenery passed by on the trip from St. Mary's to her apartment. There was nothing to say. She nodded a goodbye as he pulled away. Leaning heavily on the ban-ister, Zoey ascended the flight of stairs up to her door.
Fumbling with her keys, she could hear her cat meowing on the inside. The door swung open, and Zoey stumbled through; little Misha, her calico, nudged her food dish across the kitchen tiles.
"Okay, Misha." Zoey gingerly opened the icebox and pulled out a small portion of roast, a leftover shed brought home from the restaurant earlier. She reached instinctively for her chef's knives. Gone. Maurice must have left them at her station. A chill swept over her. "It's okay. I'll get them tomorrow. I'll be okay." She would simply have to improvise. She plucked a fork from a nearby drawer with her off hand, picked apart the chunk of roast, and tipped the meat into Misha's bowl. The calico trotted over faithfully and set about to eating, purring all the while. Zoey knelt to scratch Misha as she ate. Her simple collar, decorated only with a St. Christopher's medal, tinkled against the food bowl. Zoey breathed deeply, muttering a simple prayer under her breath.
Misha wasn't her first cat, but the psychiatrist had said that maybe a new cat would help with the flash-backs. After what had happened to Sasha- -It was those tiny people, I know it. With Misha fed, Zoey studied the roast. Was she hungry? Meat. Red and glistening. She put it away, staggered to her bed. Her hand reached out for a knife but couldn't find one. Maybe it was for the best. She collapsed again, her vision darkening.

THE SEQUENCE WAS ALWAYS THE SAME.
The alley and the dumpster, the smell coming from the back. The rhythm of a thick cleaver through a thigh-bone, like Zoey had cut hundreds of times for marrow appetizers.
A little sel gris, a little roasted garlic, a few toast points...
But the smell? Like pork, but off. She had heard the rumors of the strange dishes served by diminutive waiters who called themselves "Tcho-Tchos," just a few doors down, but she simply attributed the tales to the cutthroat nature of the culinary world. A restaurant lived and died by its reputation, after all.
She still didn't know why she had cut through the alley that night. To get home faster? A change of pace?
The door had hung open, and two small men with toothy grins had stared back out at her. "Long pig" shed heard it called, but it was no pig on their butcher's table.

It was a young man: a blond-haired twenty-something, dead and drained of blood, his thigh bone split and ready for the broiler.
A flash of red and silver. The toothy murderers slashed open across the restaurant floor. Her favorite knife dripping as she gasped in horror and incredulity.
Then, running through the blackness of the Arkham streets. Collapsing in the shower, reciting "Rejoice Mary" over and over again, as the water ran red down the drain.

ZOEY SAT UP. HER VISION HAD CLEARED.

эссе на тему : факторы необходимости проведения реинжиниринга

Современный бизнес существует в условиях быстро меняющейся среды и конкуренции, что требует от компаний постоянного развития и приспособления к новым условиям. Реинжиниринг - это один из методов изменения бизнес-процессов компании, который позволяет значительно улучшить эффективность и качество работы. В данном эссе рассмотрим факторы, которые обуславливают необходимость проведения реинжиниринга.

Во-первых, конкуренция. Конкурентное окружение, в котором функционирует бизнес сегодня, заставляет компании постоянно совершенствоваться и вносить изменения в свою деятельность. Реинжиниринг бизнес-процессов - это возможность перестроиться и адаптироваться к новым условиям быстрее, чем конкуренты. Он позволяет увеличить скорость обработки заказов, сократить затраты на производство, увеличить качество продукции и т.д.

Во-вторых, изменение рыночных условий. Например, появление новых технологий или изменение потребительских требований. Если компания не сможет быстро адаптироваться к новым условиям, то она рискует потерять своих клиентов и свою долю на рынке. Реинжиниринг бизнес-процессов помогает компании быстро перестроиться и изменить свою деятельность.

В-третьих, необходимость улучшения качества продукции или услуг. Реинжиниринг позволяет обнаружить недостатки в бизнес-процессах и устранить их, что приводит к повышению качества продукции или услуг. Это позволяет компании сохранить своих клиентов и привлекать новых.

В-четвертых, необходимость сокращения затрат. Реинжиниринг позволяет оптимизировать бизнес-процессы и сократить затраты на производство или на оказание услуг. Например, удаление неэффективных этапов производственной цепочки, сокращение времени, затрачиваемого на выполнение задачи, и другие меры позволяют уменьшить расходы компании.

В-пятых, реинжиниринг позволяет повысить мотивацию и производительность сотрудников. Улучшение бизнес-процессов, оптимизация рабочих процессов и обеспечение лучшего качества продукции могут привести к увеличению мотивации сотрудников. Повышение мотивации, в свою очередь, может увеличить производительность работников и способствовать росту прибыли компании.

Таким образом, реинжиниринг бизнес-процессов является необходимым инструментом для компаний, которые хотят успешно соперничать на рынке. Он позволяет быстро и эффективно адаптироваться к новым условиям, улучшить качество продукции, сократить затраты и повысить мотивацию сотрудников. Однако, перед тем как приступать к реинжинирингу бизнес-процессов, компании должны оценить необходимость и подготовиться к этому процессу.
I need a batch file that stops and starts a windows service

To stop and start a Windows service using batch files, you can use the following commands:

To stop a service:
```
net stop service_name
```
where "service_name" is the name of the service you want to stop.

To start a service:
```
net start service_name
```
where "service_name" is the name of the service you want to start.

To create a batch file, follow these steps:

1. Open Notepad or any other plain text editor.
2. Type the command to stop the service followed by the command to start the service on separate lines. For example:
```
net stop wuauserv
net start wuauserv
```
3. Save the file with a ".bat" extension, for example, "restart_wuauserv.bat".

You can now run the batch file by double-clicking it or running it from the command prompt. This will stop and then start the service specified in the file.
MobileNetV1算法

MobileNetV1 是一种轻量级的卷积神经网络，旨在为移动设备和嵌入式设备的计算和内存限制设计。MobileNetV1具有以下特点： 

1.深度可分离卷积： 将标准卷积替换为深度可分离卷积，从而减少模型参数和计算量。深度可分离卷积将标准卷积拆分成两个步骤：深度卷积和逐点卷积。深度卷积将输入通道卷积为不同的输出通道，而逐点卷积将不同通道的特征图组合为最终输出。

2.宽度多样化： MobileNetV1通过引入宽度乘数来控制网络的宽度。通过选择不同的宽度乘数，可以从较轻的网络（例如宽度乘数为0.25）到更重的网络（例如宽度乘数为1.0）。

3.线性激活和全局平均池化：在网络的后面部分，MobileNetV1使用线性激活替代非线性激活函数（例如ReLU），以帮助保持信息的线性度和流动性。此外，网络使用全局平均池化来减少参数数量和内存使用。

MobileNetV1在 ImageNet 图像分类任务上表现出与其他较轻型网络（例如SqueezeNet, ShuffleNet）相当的准确率，而其计算和内存占用明显少于这些网络。

Our three main characters, Aki, Yoko, and Hana, are best friends who are members of the drama club. They're all seniors and this is their last cultural festival. They decided to roam around the festival grounds, trying various activities.

Characters:
1. Aki (18 years old) - Aki is the protagonist of this scene. She has a round face with a button nose and big, round eyes that are often accentuated with makeup. Aki has long, straight black hair that goes down her back. She's wearing her school uniform, which consists of a white button-up shirt, a navy-blue short pleated skirt, a navy-blue blazer, white knee socks, and black penny loafers. She also sports a red ribbon tied around the collar of her shirt as a bow.

2. Yoko (17 years old) - Yoko is Aki's best friend. She has a slim face with high cheekbones, a small nose, and almond-shaped eyes. She has shoulder-length light brown hair with bangs that are often tucked behind her ears. Yoko is wearing the same school uniform as Aki, but with a different-colored bow - she opts for a forest green instead of red.

3. Hana (18 years old) - Hana is the third member of the trio. She sports a pixie cut with dark brown hair, beautiful full lips, and expressive eyes. Hana's look concludes with a school uniform like her friends, but her bow is light yellow in color.

Scene 1: The girls gather at the entrance of the cultural festival, excited peering down the decorated halls and at outdoor booths.

Aki: (Eyes sparkling) "There are so many activities this year! I can't wait to try them all out."
Yoko: (Smirking) "Just remember, Aki, we have our performance later, so don't go too crazy."
Hana: (Nodding) "Let's make sure we have plenty of time to go back to the drama club before our show starts."

The girls nod in agreement and decide to start at the outdoor booths, trying their luck at ring toss, eating takoyaki, and making cute faces in the photo booth. They laugh and enjoy each other's company while taking part in the activities.

Scene 2: As they continue to roam the festival grounds, Aki starts to feel a rumbling in her stomach. She tries to ignore it until it becomes unbearable, but doesn't want to ruin the fun, so she doesn't mention it to her friends. As they move on to another booth, Aki spots a spicy curry stall, and her stomach churns even harder. She can no longer ignore her body's response.

Aki: (Clutching her stomach) "Uhm, guys, I think I need to take a quick bathroom break."
Yoko: (Looking at Aki with concern) "Are you okay, Aki?"
Hana: (Patting Aki's back) "We can walk you there if you want."

Scene 3: As the girls make their way to the bathroom, Aki's stomach continues to protest, and her bowels start to cramp. She knows she won't make it to the bathroom in time, and her face turns pale as she panics.

Aki: (Desperate) "I-I'm not gonna make it!"

一个完整的元数据采集设计需要包括以下方面：

1. 数据源识别：需要识别数据源类型，例如数据库、文件、API、消息队列等，以及其所属组织、负责人等信息。

2. 元数据定义：需要定义采集的元数据种类，例如表、字段、索引等，以及相关的属性，例如大小、数据类型、唯一性、约束等。

3. 采集方式：需要确定元数据采集的方式，例如读取数据库的数据字典，解析文件头部信息等。

4. 采集频率：需要确定采集元数据的频率，例如每天、每周、每月等。

5. 元数据存储：需要确定元数据存储的方式和位置，例如存储在数据库中、存储在元数据管理工具中等。

6. 元数据的格式和标准：需要确定元数据的格式和标准，例如遵循特定的元数据管理标准、遵循特定的数据建模规范等。

7. 定期检查：需要定期检查元数据采集的质量和准确性，并进行修正和更新。

对于多个数据源的元数据采集设计，需要考虑以下问题：

1. 不同数据源的元数据结构不同，需要设计多种元数据采集方法，确保能够适应不同数据源的元数据结构。

2. 数据源的访问权限不同，需要考虑如何获取各个数据源的权限，并将元数据采集工具与访问权限集成在一起。

3. 不同数据源的更新频率不同，需要区别对待，采用不同的采集策略，确保采集数据的准确性和实时性。

4. 不同数据源的标准和格式不同，需要进行数据格式转换和标准化，确保元数据在整个系统中能够无障碍传递和使用。

在多个数据源的元数据采集工作中，需要建立一个完整的元数据管理系统，加强元数据的归类、分析、挖掘和应用。同时，需要定期对元数据进行清理、更新和维护，确保元数据的质量和准确性。

滚花过盈配合

滚花过盈配合是机械加工中一种重要的配合方式，通常用于实现高精度、高质量的机械零部件的拼装。

滚花过盈配合的原理是通过对零件进行加工，使其表面形成特定的花纹，然后与同样加工过特定花纹的其他零件配合，从而实现紧密地拼合。

在这个过程中，零件的花纹需要尽量精确地控制，以保证拼接时的准确度和可靠性。同时，还需要注意花纹的过盈量，即零件之间的配合间隙，过盈量太大或太小都会影响拼接的质量。

滚花过盈配合常用于汽车、航空等高精度领域的机械加工中，能够实现高精度、高质量的配合，大大提高了机械零部件的可靠性和耐用性。

Группами сложных предлогов называются предлоги, которые состоят из двух и более простых предлогов, обычно соединенных союзами и или или. Примерами сложных предлогов являются: перед (во) вниманием; вместо (взамен, в качестве); вместе с (вместе, в сопровождении); в отношении (в связи с); во время (в процессе); из-за (вследствие); после (вслед за); с помощью (при помощи); на столько (настолько, до такой степени, что); наряду с (наравне с); в течение (в продолжение); благодаря (по причине); в силу (в соответствии с); кроме (за исключением); с точки зрения (по отношению к); согласно (в соответствии с); в зависимости от (в соответствии с).

Сложный предлог сохраняет в себе значения простых предлогов, а также может приобрести новое значение, которое определяется контекстом. В русском языке характерно, что сложный предлог часто пишется раздельно, а иногда может писаться через дефис. Правописание сложных предлогов следует уточнять в словаре русского языка.
