3. Add a capacitor and a resistor at the output of the LM386 amplifier to create a low-pass filter that will block high-frequency noise and prevent the diode from overheating:
   a. Solder the 10uF capacitor between the output terminal of the LM386 and the ground. Ensure that the positive (longer) leg of the capacitor connects to the output terminal of the LM386.
   b. Solder the 10k Ohm resistor in parallel with the capacitor, i.e., connect one end of the resistor to the output terminal of the LM386 and the other end to the ground.

4. Connect the diode rectifier to the output of the amplifier:
   a. Solder the anode (the terminal without the stripe) of the diode to the output terminal of the LM386, where the capacitor and the resistor are also connected.
   b. Solder the cathode (the terminal with the stripe) of the diode to a wire that will be used to connect to the light bulb.

5. Connect a capacitor in parallel with the light bulb to smooth the output DC voltage and make the light less flickery:
   a. Solder a capacitor (100uF or more) with its negative (shorter) leg connected to the cathode of the diode and its positive (longer) leg connected to a wire that will be used to connect to the light bulb.

6. Connect the light bulb to the device:
   a. Connect the positive wire from the light bulb to the wire connected to the output capacitor's positive leg.
   b. Connect the negative wire of the light bulb to the ground.

7. Power the LM386 amplifier with an appropriate voltage source, such as a battery or a DC power supply. Make sure to observe the correct polarity.

--add-drop-table是默认开启的吗？在哪个版本才开始有默认开启的呢？

`--add-drop-table` 不是一个默认开启的功能。它是一个可选参数，可用于在生成的 SQL 脚本中为每个创建表的语句添加一个 `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS` 语句。这样，在运行该脚本时，如果表已经存在，则会先删除现有的表然后重新创建新表。

`--add-drop-table` 参数可用于在 MySQL 数据库的备份和转储操作中。例如，使用 `mysqldump` 工具时可以选择性地包含或排除此参数。不同版本的 MySQL 或者类似的用于数据库导出/导入的工具（例如：`pg_dump` 用于 PostgreSQL）可能也有类似的参数。然而，它不是一种默认开启的功能，并且在使用这些工具时需要根据实际需求显式指定参数。

Bella, the stunning cheerleader, strutted across the college campus, her bright red curls tumbling in the wind as she made her way towards the wrestling gym. She knew she had the attention of the boys at college and loved nothing more than playfully toying with them. Her cheerleading outfit hugged her curves and showed off her toned legs, which were the result of years of athletic training.

Tommy, the giant wrestler, was hoisting a barbell over his head, beads of sweat glistening on his forehead. He had a rugged charm about him, with chiseled features, and a stoicism that was almost mythical. He grunted as he lowered the barbell and was preparing to heave it up once more when his eyes met Bella's.

With a sly smile, Bella changed direction towards the wrestling team. Eric, the slim wrestler, was also in the gym that day. He noticed Bella coming towards them but nervously shuffled to the side, trying his best to avoid her gaze. Unlike Tommy, he was shy around girls, despite his usual cheerful demeanor.

Bella approached the group of wrestlers, her eyes still locked on Tommy.

"Hey there," she flirted, leaning against the wall. "I was just thinking about how bored I am. Anyone up for a little challenge?"

Tommy couldn't resist a dare. After all, he was the toughest guy on the team. "What kind of challenge?" he asked cautiously, barely disguising the intrigue in his voice.

"Oh, just a little friendly wrestling match. Think you can handle me?" she replied, playfully flexing her leg muscles.

Tommy smirked. "Are you kidding? I could handle you with one arm tied behind my back."

"What about a challenge that isn't just about brute strength?" she countered, placing her hands on her hips. "How about escaping a leg lock?"

Eric, watching the exchange from the sidelines, couldn't suppress a giggle. Bella challenged the biggest guy in the place for a leg lock. He couldn't imagine there was any way she could win.

Tommy raised an eyebrow but agreed. "Alright, I'll humor you. Let's do it."

The two faced each other on the mat, and Bella let Tommy make the first move. Tommy lunged, intending to scoop her up and toss her onto the mat, but with a quick, graceful twist, Bella snaked her legs around Tommy's ribs, securing her ankles together. She winked at him playfully. "Ready to tap out?"

Tommy couldn't help but chuckle at her confidence. "You're kidding, right?" he retorted, grabbing her thighs and trying to pry them away from his body. She had him in a solid hold, but there was no way she could keep him trapped.

Bella laughed, and squeezed tighter. "Nope! You'll never get out of this leg lock!"

Tommy's breath hitched as she tightened her grip; her powerful legs were locking him in place far more effectively than he had anticipated. He struggled to keep up a tough act, refusing to accept defeat to the vivacious cheerleader. "No problem at all," he grunted, pushing harder against Bella's legs.

But with every attempt to free himself, Bella would only tighten her grip even more. Her cheerleading background provided her with incredible strength and flexibility, which served her well in this impromptu wrestling match. She taunted Tommy with each failed effort. "Aw, come on, big guy. Is that really all you've got?"

Sweat dripped down Tommy's forehead as he attempted to maintain his composure. He couldn't believe Bella had managed to hold him off this long. A relentless look of determination crossed his face as he continued to push at her legs, gritting his teeth as her thighs flexed around him.

Meanwhile, the wrestling team had gathered around the pair, watching the spectacle with excitement. Eric couldn't believe his eyes: Bella was holding her own and even dominating the giant wrestler.

Tommy continued, giving every ounce of strength he had to grappling with Bella's legs. As much as he fought, however, she kept him locked in her vice-like grip. Bella's laughter rang out over the noise of the gathered crowd.

The realization began to set in for Tommy – he couldn't break free. For the first time in his life, he had met his match. Embarrassed but impressed, he finally brought his hand down on the mat.

"You win," he admitted, the stoic wrestler now humbled. Bella released her grip, and Tommy took a deep breath, still trying to process the turn of events.

Bella smiled, satisfied with her accomplishment, and offered her hand to help Tommy up. He begrudgingly took it and pulled himself to his feet.

"Guess I underestimated you," he said, shaking his head. "Good match."

Bella winked at him. "You too. But like I always say... never underestimate the power of a cheerleader's legs."

The wrestlers laughed, some clapping Tommy on the back, as they dispersed from the scene. Tommy remained in stunned silence, replaying the match in his head, while Eric couldn't help but shoot Bella an impressed smile. Maybe, from that day on, the wrestling team would have a bit more respect for a cheerleader's strength.

It is known Integrate[Power[e,max{x,y}],{y,0,3},{x,0,3}] = aPower[e,3]+b. Find a-b.

To make the variables lowercase and separate the exponential factor, we will first rewrite the integral as follows:

Integrate[e^Max[x, y], {y, 0, 3}, {x, 0, 3}].

Now let's split this double integral into two parts, one for x > y and another for x < y:

Integrate[e^x, {y, 0, x}, {x, 0, 3}] + Integrate[e^y, {x, 0, y}, {y, 0, 3}].

First, let's solve the integral containing e^x:

Integrate[e^x, {y, 0, x}, {x, 0, 3}] = Integrate[e^x, {x, 0, 3}, {y, 0, x}] = Integrate[e^x * x, {x, 0, 3}].
Now integrate e^x * x with respect to x:
Integrate[e^x * x, {x, 0, 3}] =  (e^3 - 1 - e^3 + 3)/(-1 + E) = 2	e^3 - e^2 + e - 3.

Next, let's find the integral containing e^y:

Integrate[e^y, {x, 0, y}, {y, 0, 3}] =	Integrate[e^y * y, {y, 0, 3}].
Now integrate e^y * y with respect to y:
Integrate[e^y * y, {y, 0, 3}] = (e^3 - 1 - e^3 + 3)/(-1 + E) = 2 e^3 - e^2 + e - 3.

Now, add those two integrals together:

2 (2 e^3 - e^2 + e - 3) = a e^3 + b.

Comparing the coefficients, we have:

a = 4, and b = -2*e^2 + 2*e - 6.

Thus, a - b = 4 - (-2*e^2 + 2*e - 6) = 2*e^2 - 2*e + 10.

ISABELLA: (sneering) Well, Clara, I never thought you’d dare show up in Playa Bonita after all these years.

目标检测模型中的评价指标Precision

Precision是目标检测模型中的一种常见评价指标，它用于衡量模型在识别出的目标中，正确标注的目标占所有标注的目标的比例。

具体地，对于一个目标检测模型，其预测出的目标包括True Positive（TP，预测为正样本且实际也为正样本）、False Positive（FP，预测为正样本但实际为负样本）和False Negative（FN，预测为负样本但实际为正样本）三种情况。那么Precision的计算公式为：

Precision = TP / (TP + FP)

从公式中可以看出，Precision的值越高，表明模型误报的概率越低，即模型更准确地标注了目标。因此，Precision是目标检测模型中非常重要的评价指标之一。

сущность и разновидность реинжиниринга

Реинжиниринг (reengineering) - это процесс кардинального пересмотра, анализа и изменения рабочих процессов в организации с целью повышения эффективности, оптимизации ресурсов и улучшения конкурентоспособности.

Существует несколько разновидностей реинжиниринга:

1. Бизнес-реинжиниринг - пересмотр и радикальное изменение всех аспектов бизнес-процессов компании с целью обеспечения наиболее быстрого и рационального достижения корпоративных целей и задач. Обычно включает принятие новых технологий, методологий и организационных структур.

2. Процессный реинжиниринг - анализ, изменение и оптимизация конкретных процессов в организации. Может касаться только одного или нескольких процессов, таких как производство, логистика, продажи и т. д.

3. Организационный реинжиниринг - направлен на изменение системы ценностей, целей и организационной культуры в компании. Может включать пересмотр миссии и ценностей компании, изменение корпоративной структуры, менеджмента и внутренних коммуникаций.

4. Технологический реинжиниринг - внедрение, обновление или замена устаревших технологий, методов и оборудования на современные и высокоэффективные. Ориентирован на повышение производительности и экономичности деятельности компании.

5. Реинжиниринг информационных систем - модернизация или создание новой информационной системы, позволяющей автоматизировать и оптимизировать процессы управления, производства и коммуникации в организации.

В зависимости от масштаба и сложности проекта, реинжиниринг может делиться на простой (частичный) и комплексный. Простой реинжиниринг направлен на улучшение отдельных элементов системы, а комплексный включает в себя кардинальные изменения во всех сферах деятельности организации.

DenseNet网络相比于传统的卷积神经网路有以下优点：

1. 更少的参数： DenseNet将前面层的输出连接到后面的层的输入中，从而减少了参数数量，使得网络更加紧凑。

2. 更好的梯度流： DenseNet中不同层之间直接的连接减少了梯度消失或者过度消除的问题，使得梯度更加容易流动和更新，从而更好地进行训练。

3. 更好的特征复用： DenseNet之间的跨层连接允许特征在网络中被复用，这样可以使得特征更加充分地被使用，通过利用低级特征来提升高级特征的性能，网络的表现可能会更好。

4. 更好的特征丰富性： DenseNet因为可以从深层网络中获取到低级特征，因此可以捕获到多层次、多尺度和多粒度的特征信息，这使得网络可以达到更高的性能。

5. 更好的泛化能力： DenseNet通过密集连接提高了信息的流动和复用，同时避免了过拟合和局部最优的问题，因此具有更好的泛化能力和更强的鲁棒性。

If the eigenvalues are distinct, their algebraic multiplicities are 1, and the sum of the dimensions of the eigenspaces will be at least 3, which means A is diagonalizable.

The characteristic polynomial of A is given by:

\(|A - \lambda I| = |\left(\begin{array}{ccc} -\lambda & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -\lambda & 1 \\ 4 & 4 & -1-\lambda \end{array}\right)|\)

Expanding the determinant, we get:

\(\lambda^3 - (-1 - \lambda)\cdot\lambda = 0\)

This is a cubic equation with 3 distinct roots, which are the eigenvalues of A. Thus, A is diagonalizable.

c. To diagonalize A, we find the eigenvectors corresponding to each eigenvalue. First, we find the eigenvalues of A by solving the characteristic equation, which we found in the previous part:

\(\lambda^3+\lambda^2-\lambda=0 => \lambda(\lambda^2+\lambda-1)=0\)

The eigenvalues of A are given by:

\(\lambda_1 = 0\)

\(\lambda_{2, 3}\) are the solutions to the equation \(\lambda^2+\lambda-1=0\). We may use the quadratic formula to find them:

\(\lambda_{2, 3} = \frac{-1\pm\sqrt{1^2 - 4\cdot 1 \cdot(-1)}}{2} = \frac{-1\pm\sqrt{5}}{2}\)

Now, we find the eigenvectors corresponding to each eigenvalue:

For \(\lambda_1 = 0\), we have:

\((\boldsymbol{A} - 0\boldsymbol{I})\mathbf{v}_1 = \boldsymbol{A}\mathbf{v}_1 = 0\)

The null space of A, in this case, is given by:

\(\text{NS}(A) = \left\{k\left(\begin{array}{c}1\\0\\4\\\end{array}\right) : k \in \mathbb{R}\right\}\)

So we can choose \(\mathbf{v}_1=(1, 0, 4)^T\) to be an eigenvector corresponding to \(\lambda_1 = 0\).

For \(\lambda_2 = \frac{-1+\sqrt{5}}{2}\), we have:

\((\boldsymbol{A} - \lambda_2\boldsymbol{I})\mathbf{v}_2 = 0\)

Solve this system of linear equations, we get:

\(\mathbf{v}_2 = \left(\begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 1 \\ \frac{1 + \sqrt{5}}{2} \end{array}\right)\), which is an eigenvector corresponding to \(\lambda_2\).

Similarly, for \(\lambda_3 = \frac{-1-\sqrt{5}}{2}\), we have:

\(\mathbf{v}_3 = \left(\begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 1 \\ \frac{1 - \sqrt{5}}{2} \end{array}\right)\), which is an eigenvector corresponding to \(\lambda_3\).

Now, we diagonalize A by constructing matrix P:

\[P = \left(\begin{array}{ccc} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 4 & \frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2} & \frac{1-\sqrt{5}}{2} \end{array}\right)\]

The inverse of P can be computed as:

\[P^{-1} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\left(\begin{array}{ccc} \frac{3+\sqrt{5}}{2} & \frac{-3+\sqrt{5}}{2} & -1 \\ -1+\sqrt{5} & -1-\sqrt{5} & 2 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \end{array}\right)\]

So, the diagonalized matrix is given by \(D = P^{-1} A P\):

\[D = \left(\begin{array}{ccc} 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & \frac{-1+\sqrt{5}}{2} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \frac{-1-\sqrt{5}}{2} \end{array}\right)\]

d. To derive a non-recursive formula for \(a_n\), we use the diagonalized matrix:

\[\left(\begin{array}{c} a_{n+1} \\ a_{n+2} \\ a_{n+3} \end{array}\right) = \boldsymbol{A}^n\left(\begin{array}{c} a_0 \\ a_1 \\ a_2 \end{array}\right) = (PDP^{-1})^n\left(\begin{array}{c} 0 \\ 0 \\ 1 \end{array}\right)\]

Since matrix multiplication is associative, we have:

\[\boldsymbol{A}^n = PD^nP^{-1}\]

So, 

\[\left(\begin{array}{c} a_{n+1} \\ a_{n+2} \\ a_{n+3} \end{array}\right) = PD^nP^{-1}\left(\begin{array}{c} 0 \\ 0 \\ 1 \end{array}\right)\]

Computing the matrix product on the right-hand side, we get:

\[a_n = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\left(\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}\right)^n - \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1-\sqrt{5}}{2}\right)^n\right)\]

e. A matrix is orthogonally diagonalizable if and only if it is a symmetric matrix. The matrix A is not symmetric, as its transpose is not equal to itself. Therefore, A is not orthogonally diagonalizable.

Deliverables
You will upload to Canvas a single .zip file, titled LastNameFirstInit_Lab8.zip, containing two separate files: 1) LastNameFirstInit_Lab8.m will contain your ABM3 code in response to Task 1, and 2) LastNameFirstInit_Lab8.pdf will contain your lab report in response to Task 2.

Terminology
State Variables
In a dynamical system (such as an Initial Value Problem), the dependent variables are also called the state variables. e.g., in Problem 5 of HW #9, x and v (or ẋ) are the state variables. These variables are often put into an array, which is called the state array. While the independent variable (usually time, for us) is not technically considered a state variable, we are primarily interested in the system state as a function of time. In our case, we will insert the independent variable as the first value in the state array and call it the augmented state array.

Mode Shapes and Natural Frequencies
Consider the vibration system below. As a two degree of freedom system, it has two natural frequencies and two mode shapes. If the two masses are both displaced to the left (by the correct distances) and released, they will each undergo perfect sinusoidal motion. Both will oscillate at the same frequency – called the first natural frequency. The first mode shape is a normalized vector representing respective signed amplitudes of their oscillations. The second mode shape and second natural frequency occur when the two masses are released after being displaced (by the correct distances) in opposite directions. In this case, the values in the mode shapes will have different signs, because the masses are moving in opposite directions.

Task #1
Write a single function script to perform the Third Order Adams-Bashforth-Moulton algorithm on a system of ordinary differential equations (IVP). The program must be able to handle any number of differential equations (an IVP with any number of state variables).
Your function m-file will receive through its header the following problem parameters (in this
exact order):
a. a cell array containing the function handles of the equations describing the time derivatives of the several state variables
b. the initial augmented state-array – a numerical row array containing the needed starting values of the independent variable and the several state variables (in the same order as the function handles in the cell array from the first input argument)
c. the step size to be used, and
d. the number of steps to take

Function Output
Your file should not return anything to the calling program. Instead, it should
i. print to screen (the command window) the final state of the system, including t, and
ii. plot a trace for each of the dependent variables as a function of time.
Plot each trace on a separate graph. To facilitate plotting, store the results of all time steps in the augmented state-array
a. each row represents the system at a different point in time
b. column 1 contains the time, and each other column contains the temporal history of a particular state variable
Store only the final result of each time step, not the predicted or non-converged corrected values. Title each plot ‘Var1’, ‘Var2’, etc. Try help plot and help title in the MATLAB command window to learn more about plotting. num2str will also be useful for creating the labels themselves.

Hints for your Function Script
Handling a System of Un-predetermined Size
Technical
Because you will not know in advance the order of the IVP your function will be asked to solve, some of the system parameters will need to be passed in as arrays, rather than as scalars. The step size and number of steps will still be scalars, but there will be an un-predetermined number of state variables, each of which will have an associated starting value and derivative expression. The starting value of each state variable is a scalar, so the collection of them can be stored in a normal array. On the other hand, your function script must be passed a separate function handle for the equation for the time derivative of each state variable. To store function handles, we must use a cell array. So then, you must be able to evaluate a function handle stored in a cell array. We did this in Lab #4, but I cover it again later in this document.
NOTE: Because your augmented state array will include time as the first value, the function stored in the nth index of the cell array is actually the derivative of the state variable in the (n+1)th index of the augmented state array.

Metaphysical
To figure out how to structure your code to deal with any size system, consult HW#9 and the notes from lab. In the HW, we performed RK3 on a 2nd order system. We can call the state variables x and v, and we can call their slopes (time derivatives) k and m, respectively. Feel free to write out and logically group the steps you took to solve the system for one timestep. Now, imagine we have 3 or 4 state variables each with their own slopes. Again, write out and logically group the steps you took to solve the system of equations. What changed about the process? Did the number of groups increase? Did the number of steps within particular groups increase? Now, we need to replace the RK3 algorithm steps with the ABM3 algorithm steps. Pay careful attention to the following differences:
a. the predictor and its modifier are performed once per time step, the corrector and its modifier are repeated until convergence each time step
b. the is no modifier on the predictor in the first time step
c. when performing the modifier steps, you use only non-modified values
d. when you check for convergence you compare only modified values

Function handles with unknown number of inputs
If you remember doing this for Modified Secant on a system of equations, then you may skip this section.
Up to now, you’ve probably only used function handles for equations that had a predetermined number of inputs. For this program, each derivative equation may be a function of the independent variable and any or all of the state variables. This is only a problem because you don’t know now (as you’re writing the function script) how many or which of the state variables will appear in each of the derivative equations. Fortunately, MATLAB allows us to put arrays into the equation function evaluation.
For example, if I define a function handle:
d1_by_dt = @(t,a) a(1) * a(3) / (2 + t);
when you ask MATLAB to evaluate the mathematical expression, MATLAB will expect to receive a scalar as the 1st argument, and an array of at least three terms as the 2nd argument. It will use the first and third terms in the array, along with the scalar, to evaluate the expression.
The augmented state array passed into the function already has t as the first value, so let’s just stick with that. Then our example equation becomes:
d1_by_dt = @(a) a(2) * a(4) / (2 + a(1));
You, of course, will have no prior knowledge of which state variables are used in each derivative expression. Therefore, for each derivative evaluation, you will need to submit an array containing the correct values of the dependent variable and all of the state variables, in the same order as the initial values in the passed-in augmented state array. When grading your code, it will be my responsibility to ensure that all of the derivative equations use the correct variables.

Function handles in cell arrays
The function handles of the derivative expressions of the several state variables will be passed to your function script in a cell array. The syntax for evaluating a function handle that is stored in a cell array is as follows:
value = array_name{n}(input1, input2, ... , inputQ)
• array_name is the name of the cell array in which the handles are stored

The given function is not a quadratic equation, but it can still have a vertex. However, we need to use a different approach to find it.

First, let's consider the absolute value part of the function: |x + 2|. This expression represents the distance between x and -2 on the number line, regardless of the sign of x. Therefore, we can rewrite the function as follows:

y = 1 * distance between x and -2

Now, if we plot this function on a coordinate plane, we will see that it is a V-shaped graph with the vertex at (-2, 0). The factor of 1 simply stretches or compresses the graph vertically, but does not change its shape or position.

However, we also need to consider the fact that the function y = |x + 2| is reflected across the x-axis when multiplied by -1 or when y is multiplied by -1, giving us:

y = -1 |x + 2|

This changes the direction of the V-shape, but the vertex remains the same, at (-2, 0). Finally, we add the constant term of 1 to shift the entire graph upwards by one unit:

y = -1 |x + 2| + 1

Therefore, the vertex of the given function y = 1 |x + 2| is at (-2, 1).

校招优点：

1、新鲜血液：校招可以为企业引入新鲜的大学生人才，为企业注入新的学术理念和实践经验。

2、人才优质：大学生通常思维敏捷，学科知识丰富，具备全球化视野，是可塑性极强的未来型人才。

3、长期合作：校招是一个长线投资，透过培养，未来的这些学生能够成为企业的骨干。

4、品牌推广：校招可以提高企业的知名度，并得到更多的人才、社会关注和支持。同时，校园招聘的宣传成本相对较低。

5、文化匹配：毕业生对企业的文化接触相对较少，所以更容易融入企业的文化。

校招缺点：

1、时间限制：校园招聘通常在每年的毕业季举行，时间不够灵活。

2、流动性大：毕业生缺乏稳定性，经常会出现不适应，离职和跳槽。

4、成本高：尽管校招成本相对于其他招聘方式较低，但仍需要企业进行统一校园招聘宣传，场地租赁等费用。同时，人才培养也需要企业较高的成本，这些成本将成为企业需要承担的负担。

In the Italian city of Siena, the world decayed. The cathedral bells tolled emptiness, and the streets choked on the stale breath of the expired; yet, darkness knew no sin.

Andrew Tate, a sinewy, grizzled container of fury, and Tristan, his younger, equally muscled brother, split the foul air with purpose. The two transcended mere siblings, forged through a crucible of torment and loss; they wore the time like the sheathed weapons at their sides.

The sun hemorrhaged golden beams over the horizon, bathing their forms in an otherworldly glow, that of warriors come to wage a battle that would never, could never, end. Men of mere flesh would have crumbed beneath such an undertow, but the brothers Taye bore the weight with casual disdain, as they did all things.

Their teeth clenched as they surveyed the landscape before them. The deformed silhouettes of decomposing denizens - the walking dead - stumbled through the streets, moaning with an insatiable desire for human flesh.

"Tristan, il coraggio della città è nelle nostre mani," Andrew murmured, his voice dancing like barbed wire over the solemn atmosphere. "Vecchio stato e nuovo."

Tristan nodded, understanding the weight that bore upon them. They stood as the last icons of a place, a people, a heritage, that could never return. "Glass windows, bravo leader," he replied.

The brotherly vernacular signaled their accord - the shared history, an intimacy that only two men at each other's backs and in each other's nightmares could share. Windows, shatterable shards of light, offered a slender pathway for them to see their survival.

The Piazza del Campo beckoned within the shattered remnants of Siena. The piazza would contain answers or oblivion, but the brothers accepted the locked doors of time with determination.

The air itself shimmered with the smell of the damned, the walking corpses staggering like bent weather vanes through the dying day. The brothers traversed alleys, shadows elongated by their footsteps, dreaming of once again tasting sweet Italian wine, as sweet illusions promised by the pictures of the past that now only mocked them.

But not all memories were liars. Patterned lines tattooed Andrew's forearm, an inked tribute and reminder to the time before, the brotherly bond immortalized with ink where the soul had first formed it.

Entering the cavernous emptiness of the piazza, the brothers welcomed the winds of coming night, feeling their masculine essence blending with the dying spirit of Siena. Here, in this place, they could become a fortress; perhaps of men, perhaps of ghosts, and perhaps... heroes.

They slinked around the banisters and corridors, like sentinels scavenging for discarded morsels of hope. In the middle of the vast piazza stood the cathedral of Siena - a once-majestic triumph of immaculate architecture, now tarnished by pestilence.

Andrew signaled for Tristan to follow as they scaled the cathedral steps, their purpose streamlined by the purity of masculine brotherhood.

They paused beneath the reliquary of conjoined saints - the mystic and the mortal - recognizing the symbolism. In the darkness, Andrew's eyes met Tristan’s, a silent oath exchanged.

Entering the cathedral, they acquired the materials necessary for their survival - blades, medical salves, and blessed water. It was within the holy confines of the house of God that the brothers Tate would make their final stand.

Like the figures of mythology ascribed to them by their very names, Andrew and Tristan sprinted back into the city, their strides cutting the darkness in front of them. Behind them came the hounds of hell, the shambling parade of the dead, spurred forth by the scent of living blood.

The cathedral offered no sanctuary but one forged in the arms of brotherhood, souls ingeminated by the fires and the aching hunger of a world turned monster.

The duo eluded countless dead hands, each ready to seize the threads of their lives and wrench them to the cheerless abyss; it was not the fear of the end that drove them forward but the worship of the stand.

And stand they did, spellbound shadows against the encroaching tide of death, as they butchered the fiends before them, the men pacing behind them, a part of them that forever dwelt in sorrow replaced by rage.

At last, amidst the ruined streets of Siena, the brothers' blood ran cold as formidable adversaries closed in. Exhaustion wore at them, and blood, mingled in the colors of lost humanity, drenched their bodies.

Clasping their weapons, they sensed the circle narrow, and Tristan met Andrew's gaze.

"Glass windows," he said one last time.

Andrew paid his brother a lopsided grin. Together, they charged into the gnashing jaws of eternity. One brother. Two walls. An unbreakable, untamable force against the backdrop of the damned world.

人工智能模型的量化是将高精度的模型转化为低精度的模型，以减少模型存储和计算的开销。剪枝是在保持模型准确度的前提下，通过去掉不必要的参数和连接来减少模型的复杂度和计算开销。知识蒸馏则是从一个大型、复杂的模型中提取出一些重要的信息，然后将这些信息转移给一个小型、简单的模型，以在保持模型准确性的同时减少其计算开销。二值化是将模型权重的值限制为两个可能的值（比如-1和+1），以减少存储和计算开销。

这些技术的目的都是减少模型计算和存储的开销，从而提高模型的速度、效率和可用性。量化和剪枝可以帮助模型在离线和在线环境中更快地运行，而知识蒸馏和二值化可以使模型在嵌入式设备等资源受限的情况下运行得更好。这些技术都是在保持模型准确度的前提下减少模型复杂度和计算开销的有效方式。

how do I create an uint8 array in python and set the values

You can create a uint8 array in python using the NumPy library. Here is an example:

```python
import numpy as np

# create a uint8 array with 5 elements
arr = np.zeros(5, dtype=np.uint8)

# set the values
arr[0] = 10
arr[1] = 20
arr[2] = 30
arr[3] = 40
arr[4] = 50

print(arr)
# Output: [10 20 30 40 50]
```

Alternatively, you can create and set the values of a uint8 array using a list comprehension like this:

```python
arr = np.array([i for i in range(5)], dtype=np.uint8)
print(arr)
# Output: [0 1 2 3 4]
```

Published: European Journal of Marketing

Summary:

The research paper explores the impact of celebrity endorsements on consumer decision-making in a performance-oriented culture. It focuses on the role of celebrity endorsers and the factors that increase their credibility, persuasiveness, and attractiveness to consumers.

The paper begins by reviewing relevant literature on celebrity endorsements, highlighting three significant roles that celebrities play in the endorsement process. These roles include the Symbolic Role, where the celebrity represents a specific image or symbol; the Functional Role, where the celebrity is perceived as an expert in their field; and the Autotelic Role, where the celebrity is admired for their unique skills or talents.

The research examines several factors that may influence consumer attitudes towards celebrity endorsers, including attractiveness, expertise, trustworthiness, and perceived similarity between the celebrity and the consumer. The study highlights how these factors can contribute to the endorsement's effectiveness, particularly in a performance-oriented culture.

The methodology of the study consists of two stages. In the first stage, an online survey was used to collect data from 841 participants, assessing their attitudes towards celebrity endorsers and their likelihood of purchasing a product endorsed by a celebrity. The second stage consisted of qualitative interviews with 27 participants, providing deeper insights into the influences behind their attitudes and behaviors.

The findings of the study indicate that all four endorsement factors positively influence consumer attitudes towards celebrity endorsers, with attractiveness being the most influential factor. The results suggest that celebrity endorsers' attractiveness and lifestyle can significantly impact consumers' desire to emulate their image by purchasing endorsed products, especially in a performance-oriented culture where success is highly valued.

Moreover, the study highlights the importance of the interaction between celebrity endorser factors and the product category. For example, expertise becomes more relevant when the celebrity endorser is promoting products related to their area of expertise, while trustworthiness is more critical for products that involve higher financial risks.

The research also suggests a significant link between perceived similarity and consumer attitudes. The more a consumer perceives themselves to be similar to the celebrity endorser, the more likely they are to be influenced by the endorsement.

The paper concludes by discussing the implications of these findings for marketing practice. First, it suggests that marketers should carefully select celebrities to endorse products based on their attractiveness, expertise, trustworthiness, and perceived similarity. Second, they should tailor their advertising messages and tactics to effectively communicate the celebrity's relevant traits and expertise. Lastly, marketers should consider selecting celebrity endorsers who are likely to have a meaningful connection with their target audience, increasing the chances of successful endorsements.

In summary, this research paper emphasizes the crucial role of celebrity endorsers in shaping consumer decision-making in a performance-oriented culture. Attractiveness, expertise, trustworthiness, and perceived similarity are critical factors in determining an endorsement's effectiveness, indicating that careful selection and communication of celebrity endorsers are essential for successful marketing campaigns.

```python
class PDFViewer:
    def __init__(self, parent):
        self.parent = parent
        self.canvas = None
        self.scrollbar = None
        self.img_list = []
        self.current_img = None
        self.load_button = Button(self.parent, text="Load PDF", command=self.load_pdf)
        self.load_button.pack()
    
    def load_pdf(self):
        pdf_file = askopenfilename(filetypes=[("PDF Files", "*pdf")])
        if pdf_file:
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as path:
                images = convert_from_path(pdf_file, output_folder=path, fmt="jpeg")
                self.img_list = images
                self.current_img = images[0]
                self.create_canvas()
                
    def create_canvas(self):
        # create canvas and scrollbar
        self.canvas = Canvas(self.parent, width=self.current_img.size[0], height=self.current_img.size[1])
        self.scrollbar = Scrollbar(self.parent, orient=VERTICAL, command=self.canvas.yview)
        self.canvas.configure(yscrollcommand=self.scrollbar.set)
        self.scrollbar.pack(side=RIGHT, fill=Y)
        self.canvas.pack(side=LEFT, fill=BOTH, expand=1)
        
        # create image on canvas
        self.canvas_img = self.canvas.create_image(0, 0, anchor=NW, image=self.current_img)
        
        # bind canvas to mousewheel scroll
        self.canvas.bind_all("<MouseWheel>", self.mouse_wheel)
        
    def mouse_wheel(self, event):
        self.canvas.yview_scroll(-1 * (event.delta // 120), "units")
        
root = Tk()
root.geometry("600x400")
```

It is known Integrate[Power[e,max{x,y}],{y,0,3},{x,0,3}] = aPower[e,3]+b. Find a and b

To find a and b, we need to evaluate the given double integral. We have:

Integrate[Power[e,max{x,y}],{y,0,3},{x,0,3}]

To evaluate this integral, we must split the integration into two cases: for x < y and for x > y (since we're integrating over the maximum of x and y).

Case 1: x < y

In this case, we have max{x,y} = y, so our integral becomes:

Integrate[Power[e,y],{y,0,3},{x,0,y}]

The inner integral is with respect to x, and since Power[e,y] does not depend on x, we can treat it as a constant:

Power[e,y] * Integrate[1,{x,0,y}]

The integral of 1 with respect to x is just x, so we have:

Power[e,y] * (y - 0) = Power[e,y] * y

Now, we must integrate this expression with respect to y, from 0 to 3:

Integrate[Power[e,y]*y,{y,0,3}]

Using integration by parts, let u = y and dv = Power[e,y]dy, then du = dy and v = Power[e,y]. Using the integration by parts formula, we have:

uv - Integrate[v*du] = y*(Power[e,y]) - Integrate[Power[e,y]dy]

Now, evaluate this expression at the limits:

(y*(Power[e,y]) - Power[e,y])|_{0}^{3}

= (3*(Power[e,3]) - Power[e,3]) - (0*(Power[e,0]) - Power[e,0])

= 2*(Power[e,3]) - 1

So, the integral for the case x < y is 2*(Power[e,3]) - 1.

Case 2: x > y

In this case, we have max{x,y} = x, so our integral becomes:

Integrate[Power[e,x],{y,0,x},{x,0,3}]

The inner integral is with respect to y, and since Power[e,x] does not depend on y, we can treat it as a constant:

Power[e,x] * Integrate[1,{y,0,x}]

The integral of 1 with respect to y is just y, so we have:

Power[e,x] * (x - 0) = Power[e,x] * x

Now, we must integrate this expression with respect to x, from 0 to 3:

Integrate[Power[e,x]*x,{x,0,3}]

Again, using integration by parts, let u = x and dv = Power[e,x]dx, then du = dx and v = Power[e,x]. Using the integration by parts formula, we have:

uv - Integrate[v*du] = x*(Power[e,x]) - Integrate[Power[e,x]dx]

Now, evaluate this expression at the limits:

(x*(Power[e,x]) - Power[e,x])|_{0}^{3}

= (3*(Power[e,3]) - Power[e,3]) - (0*(Power[e,0]) - Power[e,0])

= 2*(Power[e,3]) - 1

So, the integral for the case x > y is also 2*(Power[e,3]) - 1.

Now, we must add the integrals for the two cases together:

(2*(Power[e,3]) - 1) + (2*(Power[e,3]) - 1) = 4*(Power[e,3]) - 2

So, we have:

Integrate[Power[e,max{x,y}],{y,0,3},{x,0,3}] = 4*(Power[e,3]) - 2 = a*(Power[e,3]) + b

Comparing the coefficients, we find:

a = 4
b = -2

explícame las formas verbales en español

En español, las formas verbales son las diferentes conjugaciones que los verbos pueden tener según su función en la oración, el tiempo en el que ocurre la acción, el aspecto de la acción y el modo en el que se expresa la acción (indicativo, subjuntivo e imperativo). A continuación, te explico los diferentes aspectos a considerar en las formas verbales:

1. Personas gramaticales: Los verbos en español se conjugan según las personas gramaticales, que son: primera persona (yo, nosotros/nosotras), segunda persona (tú, vosotros/vosotras, usted, ustedes) y tercera persona (él/ella, ellos/ellas). Cada persona tiene una conjugación específica para cada tiempo, modo y aspecto.

2. Tiempos verbales: Estos indican cuándo ocurre la acción del verbo en relación al tiempo de habla. Los tiempos básicos son: presente, pasado y futuro. El pasado se puede subdividir en pretérito perfecto (acción concluida en el pasado), pretérito imperfecto (acción en progreso en el pasado), pretérito pluscuamperfecto (acción concluida antes de otra acción en el pasado) y pretérito anterior (acción anterior inmediata a otra en el pasado). También existen los tiempos compuestos, en los que se utiliza el verbo auxiliar haber conjugado más un participio (por ejemplo, he hablado, había comido, habré llegado).

3. Aspecto verbal: El aspecto indica si la acción está concluida o en proceso. En español, se distinguen el aspecto perfectivo (acción concluida) y el imperfectivo (acción en proceso). El aspecto se ve reflejado en la conjugación de los diferentes tiempos verbales.

4. Modos verbales: Los modos verbales indican la actitud del hablante respecto a la acción.
  
  * Indicativo: Es el modo más común y se utiliza para expresar acciones reales, hechos o certezas.
  * Subjuntivo: Se utiliza para expresar acciones hipotéticas, deseos, dudas, emociones o situaciones eventuales.
  * Imperativo: Se emplea para dar mandatos, órdenes, sugerencias o prohibiciones.
  
Cabe mencionar que también existen las formas no personales del verbo, que son el infinitivo (hablar, comer, vivir), el gerundio (hablando, comiendo, viviendo) y el participio (hablado, comido, vivido). Estas formas no se conjugan según las personas gramaticales y, en general, no indican tiempo ni modo.

En resumen, las formas verbales en español son las distintas variaciones de un verbo según la persona, el tiempo, el aspecto y el modo en el que se expresa la acción que denota. Estas formas son fundamentales para construir el significado y la estructura de una oración en español.

что произойдет с яблоком на луне

На Луне отсутствует атмосфера, поэтому с яблоком не произойдет никаких процессов, связанных с воздействием атмосферы, таких как обычные окислительные процессы при контакте с кислородом. Если яблоко будет на поверхности Луны без какой-либо защиты, то оно подвергнется различным космическим условиям, таким как окружающий вакуум, крайне низкая температура на теневой стороне Луны, крайне высокая температура на солнечной стороне Луны, а также ультрафиолетовому (UV) и космическому излучению.

Под действием низкой температуры и вакуума яблоко замерзнет и потеряет весь свой внутренний газ, вода в нем превратится в лед и испарится напрямую из твердого состояния, проходя потом через процесс сублимации. Если же яблоко оказывается на солнечной стороне Луны, где температура значительно выше, оно вполне может загореться на солнечном свете и сгореть. Продолжительное воздействие ультрафиолетового и космического излучения также может вызвать различные химические и физические изменения в яблоке, например, разрушение его молекулярных структур.

В итоге яблоко претерпит множество физических и химических изменений, включая замерзание, испарение и возможное выгорание на солнечной стороне Луны. Однако процессы, связанные с разложением на Земле, такие как высыхание, гниение и кисление, не смогут произойти без воздуха и бактерий.

产品成本构成结构

产品成本构成结构通常包括以下几个部分：

1. 直接材料成本：指用于制造产品的原材料、辅料、部件等的费用，如钢材、塑料、电子元件等。

2. 直接人工成本：指直接参与生产过程的员工所产生的工资、福利等费用。

3. 制造费用：指在生产过程中产生的与产品制造相关的其他成本，如设备折旧、能源消耗、水电费等。

4. 研发成本：指为开发新产品或改进现有产品而投入的研究和开发费用。

5. 营销成本：指为推广和销售产品所投入的费用，如广告费、促销活动支出、销售人员薪酬等。

6. 管理成本：指企业进行日常管理、人力资源管理、财务核算等所产生的成本。

7. 运输成本：指产品从生产地到消费者手中所产生的运输费用，如物流费、运费等。

8. 包装成本：指为保护和美化产品所投入的包装材料和包装工艺的费用。

9. 售后服务成本：指为保障消费者权益，提供售后服务所产生的成本，如退换货、维修保养等。

10. 资本成本：指企业为获取资金所付出的成本，如利息支出、股息等。

通过分析产品成本构成结构，企业可以找到降低成本的方法，提高产品的竞争力。在成本管理过程中，需要重点关注直接材料、直接人工和制造费用等成本要素。同时，企业还需要综合考虑市场环境、客户需求等因素，实现成本在整个产品生命周期中的最优化。

Tell us very much about international currency systems and their changes

International currency systems refer to the mechanism that governs the exchange of currencies between countries. It plays a vital role in global trade and economic growth by facilitating the transfer of goods and services across borders. The most commonly used currency system is the floating exchange rate system, where the value of currencies is determined by their supply and demand in the market. However, there have been several significant changes in the international currency system over the years.

One of the major changes in the international currency system was the Bretton Woods Agreement in 1944, which established the U.S. dollar as the world's reserve currency. It also pegged the exchange rate of the dollar to gold, allowing other countries to convert their dollars into gold at a fixed rate. This system worked well until the 1970s when the U.S. had to abandon the gold standard, and the floating exchange rate system took over.

In the 1980s, the Plaza Accord was signed to depreciate the value of the U.S. dollar and boost the export competitiveness of other countries like Japan and Germany. This agreement succeeded in increasing exports from these countries but led to a massive trade imbalance.

Another significant change in the international currency system was the creation of the Euro in 1999, which replaced the currencies of several European countries. It allowed for better economic integration and facilitated international trade between European countries.

In recent years, China's growing economic power has led to a push to internationalize the Chinese Yuan. Many countries have started including the Yuan in their foreign exchange reserves, and China has signed currency swap agreements with several countries to facilitate trade in their respective currencies.

In conclusion, the international currency system has undergone significant changes over the years, reflecting the changing global economic landscape. These changes have aimed to facilitate international trade and economic growth, and it remains to be seen what future changes will take place as countries continue to grow and evolve.

要使用Scrapy来编写一个爬取Bing搜索结果的程序，首先需安装并创建一个新的Scrapy项目。此处假设你具备Python的基础知识，已经安装了Scrapy。以下是创建并运行一个简单Bing搜索结果爬虫的指南：

1. 安装Scrapy（如果还没有安装）：

```bash
pip install scrapy
```

2. 创建一个新的Scrapy项目：

```bash
scrapy startproject bing_scraper
cd bing_scraper
```

3. 创建一个名为`bing_spider.py`的新爬虫文件，保存到`bing_scraper/spiders/`目录：

```python
import scrapy

class BingSpider(scrapy.Spider):
    name = 'bing'
    allowed_domains = ['bing.com']

    def start_requests(self):
        query = 'scrapy tutorial'
        url = f'https://bing.com/search?q={query}'
        yield scrapy.Request(url=url, callback=self.parse)

    def parse(self, response):
        results = response.css('.b_algo')
        for result in results:
            title = result.css('h2 a::text').get()
            link = result.css('h2 a::attr(href)').get()
            snippet = result.css('.b_caption p::text').get()

            yield {
                'title': title,
                'link': link,
                'snippet': snippet,
            }
```

此文件中定义了一个继承自`scrapy.Spider`的类`BingSpider`。`start_requests`方法会启动请求流程，将查询字符串变量`query`传递给Bing搜索。然后`parse`方法会处理Bing搜索结果，并将标题、链接、摘要返回为生成器。

4. 在项目的根目录下运行爬虫：

```bash
scrapy crawl bing
```

这将开始爬取Bing的搜索结果。

5. 若要将爬取的内容输出到一个文件中，例如JSON格式，请运行以下命令：

```bash
scrapy crawl bing -O output.json
```

这会将爬取的搜索结果保存在项目的根目录下的名为`output.json`的文件中。

注意：许多网站可能具有反爬虫机制。为遵守网络道德规范，请在编写爬虫时遵循目标站点的`robots.txt`文件中列出的规则。此外，网站架构可能也会发生变化，此示例程序可能需要针对新的DOM结构进行更新才能继续运行。建议用Selenium与动态代理等方法获得更健壮的爬虫。

explain in detail and derive the equation for inversion modelling of 1 dimensional vertical electrical sounding resistivity data using least squares method and root mean squares

Inversion modeling of 1-dimensional vertical electrical sounding (VES) resistivity data involves determining the true resistivity and thickness of subsurface layers by interpreting apparent resistivity data measured on the surface. The least squares method and root mean square (RMS) error are commonly used techniques for refining the interpretation of VES data.

Let's first discuss the VES data and the concept of apparent resistivity:

1. Vertical Electrical Sounding (VES): VES is a geophysical method used to investigate the electrical resistivity of subsurface layers by injecting an electrical current into the ground and measuring the voltage at specific points on the surface. The data obtained is then used to estimate the resistivity of the subsurface layers.

2. Apparent Resistivity (ρa): The ratio of the measured voltage to the injected current is used to calculate the apparent resistivity, which is an averaged value of the true resistivities of the subsurface layers.

Now let's discuss the least squares method and its application to VES inversion modeling:

1. The Least Squares method: The least squares method is an optimization technique that aims to minimize the sum of the squared differences between observed values and predicted values. In the context of VES inversion modeling, the least squares method is used to iteratively adjust the model parameters (true resistivities and thicknesses) to minimize the discrepancy between the observed apparent resistivities and the apparent resistivities calculated from the model.

Now we will derive the equations for inversion modeling of 1-dimensional VES resistivity data using the least squares method and RMS error:

1. Define the forward model: Let's consider a 1-dimensional subsurface consisting of 'n' horizontal layers with true resistivities (ρi) and thicknesses (hi), where i=1,2,...,n. The forward model is the relation between these true resistivities and thicknesses and the observed apparent resistivities. This relation can be described by the integral equation governing the VES measurements, where ρa is the apparent resistivity at a particular point, K is a geometric factor accounting for the electrode configuration, ρ and z are the true resistivity and depth of the subsurface layers at any point, and J(ρ,z) is the sensitivity kernel.

2. Discretize the true resistivities and thicknesses: Since we are dealing with discrete layer thicknesses and resistivities, we can represent the continuous integral equation on a discretized grid. Let ρi and hi be the true resistivity and thickness of the ith layer. Then the forward model can be represented by the matrix equation:
   ρa = G * m
   where ρa is the vector of observed apparent resistivities, G is the Jacobian matrix consisting of sensitivity kernels J(ρ,z), and m is the model vector containing the true resistivities (ρi) and thicknesses (hi).

3. Calculate the misfit function: The misfit function is the measure of the difference between the observed apparent resistivities and the apparent resistivities calculated using the current model. It can be defined as:
   misfit(m) = sum((ρa_obs - ρa_calc)^2)
   where ρa_obs and ρa_calc are the observed and calculated apparent resistivities respectively.

4. Minimize the misfit function using the least squares method: Our goal is to find the model parameters (true resistivities and thicknesses) that minimize the misfit function. This can be achieved using the least squares method:
   m_LS = (G^T * G)^(-1) * G^T * ρa_obs
   where m_LS is the least squares solution, G^T is the transpose of the Jacobian matrix, and (G^T * G)^(-1) is the inverse of the product of the Jacobian matrix and its transpose.

5. Calculate the RMS error: After obtaining the least squares solution, we can calculate the RMS error to assess the goodness-of-fit of the model:
   RMS = sqrt(sum((ρa_obs - ρa_calc)^2) / N)
   where N is the number of VES data points.

In summary, inversion modeling of 1-dimensional VES resistivity data using the least squares method involves creating a forward model relating the subsurface layer resistivities and thicknesses to the observed apparent resistivities, discretizing the model parameters, minimizing the misfit function using the least squares process, and evaluating the performance of the model using the RMS error.

Используй nasm 32 bit и printf/scanf Необходимо прочитать с клавиатуры три числа, вычесть из первого остальные и вывести результат в виде равенства в соответствии с примером.
Пример ввода: 14 6 3
Пример вывода: 14-6-3 =5.

```asm
section .data
    fmt db "%d-%d-%d = %d.", 10, 0 ; формат для printf
section .bss
    a resd 1 ; первое число
    b resd 1 ; второе число
    c resd 1 ; третье число
    res resd 1 ; результат вычитания
section .text
    global _start

_start:
    ; ввод чисел с клавиатуры
    ; первое число
    push a ; адрес переменной
    push dword fmt ; формат для scanf
    call scanf ; вызов функции scanf
    add esp, 8 ; очистка стека

    ; второе число
    push b ; адрес переменной
    push dword fmt ; формат для scanf
    call scanf ; вызов функции scanf
    add esp, 8 ; очистка стека

    ; третье число
    push c ; адрес переменной
    push dword fmt ; формат для scanf
    call scanf ; вызов функции scanf
    add esp, 8 ; очистка стека

    ; вычитаем второе и третье число из первого
    mov eax, [a]
    sub eax, [b]
    sub eax, [c]
    mov [res], eax

    ; вывод результата на экран
    push dword [res] ; результат
    push c ; третье число
    push b ; второе число
    push a ; первое число
    push dword fmt ; формат для printf
    call printf ; вызов функции printf
    add esp, 20 ; очистка стека

    ; завершение программы
    mov eax, 1 ; код завершения
    xor ebx, ebx ; стандартный поток вывода
    int 0x80 ; вызов системного вызова
```

如何辨别一个问题为设计问题

设计问题通常具有以下特点：

1. 以解决问题或改进某个方案为目的：设计问题主要关注解决现存的问题或提高现有系统、过程、产品、服务等的性能。

2. 需要创新思维：设计问题需要利用创新、独特的方法和观点来解决问题，如构建原型、实施新策略、开发技术等。

3. 存在多个可行方案：设计问题通常没有“标准答案”或正确答案，而是有多个可能的解决方案。设计师需要权衡各种方案的优缺点，包括功能性、可行性、效率、经济性、可持续性等因素。

4. 需要跨学科知识和技能：设计问题往往需要综合多个领域的知识和技能，如技术、美学、业务、心理学等。设计师需要具备相应的知识和技能，以便解决问题。

5. 用户体验至关重要：设计问题关注用户体验，设计师需要理解目标用户的需求、期望和行为，确保设计方案符合用户需求。

6. 整个过程是迭代的：设计问题通常需要经过多次迭代，从概念到实际实施，期间需要进行不断的调整、测试和评估。

7. 含有一定的主观性和个人风格：设计问题通常会反映设计师的个人观点、审美偏好和价值观。同时，不同的人对同一个设计问题可能有不同的看法和期望。

总之，设计问题具有解决问题或改进目的、多种可能方案、注重用户体验、需要创新思维和跨学科知识，并具有一定的主观性和个性化特点。

```python
import requests
``` 

Title: Is It Safe to Visit Morocco?

Introduction

A journey to Morocco sparks images of bustling souks, majestic deserts, and rich cultural experiences waiting to be discovered. In this article, we will explore the safety of travelling to this mesmerizing North African destination, while offering tips and precautions for you to follow along the way.

A General Look at Morocco's Safety

Morocco, for the most part, is a safe and hospitable country for travellers. The government takes tourism seriously and prioritises the need to maintain security and stability. While petty crime such as pickpocketing and scams can be a concern, especially in crowded areas or tourist hotspots, Morocco is generally considered safer than many other popular tourist destinations across the world.

In terms of political stability, Morocco enjoys a strong and stable government. Although the country faced protests related to economic grievances in recent years, these demonstrations have not led to significant violence or instability, and mainly occurred far from the primary tourists' areas.

Terrorism Concerns

It's important to address the elephant in the room: Terrorism. No country is immune to the threat of terrorism, and though Morocco has been relatively sheltered compared to other nations, a few isolated incidents have occurred throughout the years. However, the Moroccan government is committed to countering terrorism and frequently cooperates with international counter-terrorism organizations. Overall, the probability of becoming a victim of a terrorist attack while visiting Morocco is extremely low.

Personal Safety

The majority of travellers visiting Morocco will encounter friendly and welcoming locals, eager to share their culture and experiences. Moroccans are known for their warmth and genuine hospitality, and they are often proud of their country's attractions and heritage sites.

However, it's worth noting that some tourists, particularly those who appear to be inexperienced or gullible, might become targets for scammers, vendors, or petty criminals. In order to minimize such risks, it's essential to make yourself aware of local customs, learn a few words in the local language, and adopt an assertive and self-assured attitude.

Reserved vigilance and simple precautions will ensure your trip is memorable for all the right reasons. Always remain aware of your surroundings, especially in crowded environments, and secure your belongings to deter pickpockets.

Safety Tips for Female Travellers

Morocco is a unique and enjoyable country for female travellers, offering a myriad of experiences to be cherished. However, it is important to remember that women may receive unwanted attention from men while travelling alone or in small groups. To minimize this attention, it is recommended to adopt modest clothing, respecting local customs and traditions. Wearing sunglasses can also serve as a barrier against unsolicited gazes.

Furthermore, avoid walking alone at night in poorly lit streets and stay in reputable accommodations. Female travellers may also benefit from joining small organized tour groups to explore unfamiliar areas.

Conclusion

The bottom line is that, like anywhere else in the world, Morocco can be a perfectly safe destination for travellers who do their research, exercise common sense precautions, and respect the local customs and traditions. With its vibrant culture, stunning landscapes, and unique charm, Morocco indeed falls under the "must-see" category for travellers worldwide. So, pack your bags and let yourself be enchanted by the magic of the Kingdom of Morocco.

Contemporary optical lines, without a doubt, offer a myriad of benefits over traditional metallic and coaxial cables, including enhanced capacity, speed, and distance, while being less susceptible to various forms of signal degradation. Moreover, advancements in optical switching equipment have been instrumental in driving the rapid growth and efficiency of these networks. 

Relevance of the Topic

Hence, a comprehensive understanding of optical lines of communication and switching equipment is not only essential for communication engineers and network technicians but also for policymakers, businesses, and society at large. The ability to harness the power of optical communication networks significantly impacts multiple sectors, including finance, education, healthcare, entertainment, and government. By ensuring the effective design, implementation, and maintenance of optical lines and switching equipment, continuities of service and long-term advancements in data communication and networking can be achieved. 

Optical Lines: Fundamentals and Advantages

Optical lines are communication channels that utilize light waves to transfer digital data over large distances. By employing optical fiber cables made up of thin strands of glass or plastic, optical lines can transmit data as electromagnetic waves, effectively converting discrete electrical signals into light pulses. This mode of transmission offers several distinct advantages over conventional lines that rely on electrical signals for data traffic - chief amongst them being reduced signal attenuation and the absence of electromagnetic interference. 

A crucial element that differentiates optical lines from traditional communication lines is their immense bandwidth capacity. Due to dispersion and attenuation properties, copper-based communication lines face limitations in terms of speed, distance, and capacity. In contrast, optical lines can support higher frequencies and transmit data over vast distances, with the potential to reach thousands of kilometers. Notably, optical lines also possess the ability to support bidirectional data transmission, further contributing to their practical utility in modern network architectures. 

Switching Equipment: The Nerve Center of Optical Communications

Optical switching equipment acts as the linchpin that connects multiple communication channels in an optic network. Switches are designed to route optical signals to their respective destinations, ensuring that the entire data communication process functions seamlessly. Optical switches outperform conventional electrical switches in terms of speed, efficiency, and scalability. Furthermore, optical switching also reduces the need for numerous conversion stages between electrical and optical domains, thereby minimizing latency.

Optical switches employ various methods, such as wavelength-division multiplexing and time-division multiplexing, to manage multiple communication channels. The development of innovative switching technologies, such as MEMS-based optical switches and all-optical switching, has significantly expanded the capabilities of these devices in terms of automation, flexibility, and responsiveness. Among emerging technologies, concepts like photonic switching and quantum communication hold great promise in shaping the future of optical networks.

Impact of Switching Equipment on Optical Lines and Network Performance

The role of switching equipment in advancing the state of optical communication cannot be overstated. Switching technologies have bolstered optical line networks' efficiency, enabling them to support high-speed data transfers, expand existing infrastructure, and adapt to emerging trends. Furthermore, advancements in switching equipment have supported the development of novel applications of optical communication.

For instance, data centers have increasingly adopted photonic switching equipment, as it significantly reduces power consumption and latency compared to conventional copper-based systems. The global internet is driven by submarine cables that must traverse oceans, where the role of switching equipment in ensuring signal quality and capacity is critical. The intricate interplay between optical lines and their supporting equipment is integral to the continued growth and performance of modern optical communication networks.

Conclusion

To summarize, optical lines of communication, supplemented by advancements in switching equipment, have profoundly impacted the world's communication landscape. As demand for data transfer continues to rise, both in terms of volume and speed, the emphasis on developing innovative and efficient optical communication networks remains critical. Mastering the intricacies of optical switching equipment is, in many ways, imperative for individuals and businesses seeking to capitalize on the many benefits of optical communication technology. Understanding the evolution and continuing development of switching equipment, in tandem with the complex network structures that they support, remains at the forefront of maintaining global connectivity in our ever-evolving digital world.

How can I reconcile the existence of a semi-steampunk metropolis in a fantasy setting that is mostly late medieval/early modern in its technology? The metropolis' economy should be based on industry and its environs should feature less magic, as opposed to the rest of the world in which it is situated. Primitive firearms are more common in this metropolis, as opposed to the rest of the world where they are extremely rare.

There are a few ways to reconcile a semi-steampunk metropolis in an otherwise late medieval/early modern world:

1. Geographic isolation: The metropolis could be geographically isolated from the rest of the world, perhaps located in a well-protected valley, on a large island, or surrounded by mountains. This would create a natural barrier that prevents other places from accessing or utilizing the technology of this advanced city.

2. A unique resource: The industrial nature of the metropolis could be built around a specific resource available only in or around the city, which enables the development of steam-powered technology. This resource could be a particular mineral deposit, or access to underground geothermal vents that provide the steam needed to power their engines. As a result, the city has a huge economic advantage over other areas, allowing it to maintain its industrial prowess without being overtaken.

3. A brilliant inventor or group of inventors: The emergence of the metropolis could be attributed to a single brilliant inventor or a group of inventors who were able to develop these technologies. This would not only explain the difference in technology levels but could also provide interesting plot hooks and stories revolving around the exploits and discoveries of these inventors.

4. A powerful patron: A powerful individual or organization within the city may have promoted and defended the development of industrial technology. This patron could be a benevolent ruler, a wealthy merchant, or even a secretive cabal working behind the scenes. Their competitive advantage and influence help ensure that the metropolis remains at the forefront of industry.

5. Knowledge suppression: To maintain their technological edge, the metropolis might actively try to suppress the spread of their discoveries to the outside world. This could come in the form of trade restrictions, limiting the sale of their unique resources, and strictly controlling access to the city. By ensuring that the rest of the world remains technologically behind, the metropolis is able to maintain its booming industrial economy.

6. Cultural or religious factors: The metropolis could embrace a particular worldview or religion that encourages the pursuit of practical knowledge and engineering, while the rest of the world holds beliefs that discourage the development of such advanced technology. This difference in belief systems not only helps explain the differences in magic and technology but could also create tension between the metropolis and other civilizations.

By considering these factors and incorporating them into your worldbuilding, you can create a believable and consistent reason for why the metropolis is so technologically advanced compared to the rest of the world. Title: The Most Beneficial Items to Elevate Your Moroccan Adventure

Introduction

The rich tapestry of experiences in Morocco is enough to send any traveler into a magical journey for the senses. From the bustling souks to the majestic Atlas Mountains, the charming culture, hospitality, and breathtaking scenery of Morocco make it an unmissable destination for any explorer at heart. While dreaming of your perfect Moroccan getaway, don't forget the importance of being adequately prepared with the right items to ensure your adventure is as smooth, comfortable, and fulfilling as possible. In this article, we've curated a list of the most beneficial items to bring along on your Moroccan escapade.

1. A Lightweight and Versatile Wardrobe

Navigating the labyrinthine streets of Moroccan cities or trekking through the golden dunes of the Sahara Desert, a lightweight and versatile wardrobe is essential. Opt for loose, breezy items in breathable materials such as linen or cotton to keep you cool during hot days, while maintaining modesty out of respect and cultural sensitivity. Include a few light layers to accommodate the cooler evenings and windy coastal breezes. Don't forget comfortable walking shoes, as Moroccan cities can involve a great deal of wandering on foot. A sun hat, sunglasses, and durable sandals are indispensable for protecting yourself against the intense African sun.

2. A Portable Power Bank and Universal Adapter

There's nothing worse than running out of battery power or having incompatible chargers when you're trying to capture those stunning Moroccan moments or navigate using GPS. Packing a portable power bank ensures you never miss a photo, sunset, or crucial call, and carrying a universal adapter means you'll have access to power outlets when needed. While Morocco uses the Europlug or Type C and Type E sockets, bringing a universal adapter will ensure you're well-equipped regardless of where your future travels may take you.

3. A Reusable Water Bottle and Travel Cutlery

Staying hydrated is essential in Morocco's arid climate, and using a reusable water bottle is an eco-conscious alternative to single-use plastic. As tap water in Morocco is not potable, consider investing in a bottle with a built-in filter to ensure a safe and clean drinking experience. In addition, packing a set of reusable travel cutlery will ensure you're ready to dig into the tantalizing Moroccan dishes available in street-side stalls and markets while keeping plastic waste to a minimum.

4. A Reliable Offline Map and Language Apps

While wandering through the winding alleys of Fes or Marrakech, having access to maps and translation services is invaluable. Install offline map applications, such as Maps.me or Google Maps offline mode, to access directions without an active internet connection. Downloading a language app with offline capabilities, like Google Translate or Simple Arabic, can also be immensely useful. These tools allow you to communicate and navigate with ease, even in the most remote areas of the country.

5. A Quality Camera and Extra Memory Cards

As you traverse Morocco's vibrant landscape, the desire to capture every mesmerizing moment will be hard to resist. Ensure you bring a quality camera to immortalize those instants of awe, whether it’s a DSLR or a reliable smartphone with a great camera. An extra memory card or cloud storage solution will give you peace of mind in knowing your photos and memories will be safe.

Conclusion

A happy traveler is a well-prepared traveler, and these essential items will make your Moroccan adventure an unforgettable one. Embrace the enchanting beauty and cultural richness of Morocco, knowing you've brought with you the most beneficial items to enhance your journey that much more. So navigate the souks with confidence, explore the Sahara sands without a worry, and approach the shores of the Atlantic with reassurance, as you marvel in the unforgettable magic of Morocco.

How to write a docker-compose yml using a Dockerfile

Assuming you already have a Dockerfile for your application, to write a docker-compose.yml, follow these steps:

1. Create a new file and name it `docker-compose.yml`. This will be the main configuration file for docker-compose.

2. In the `docker-compose.yml` file, start with specifying the version of Docker Compose being used. For example, `version: '3'`.

3. Next, specify the services you want to run using the `services` keyword. For each service, you'll need to provide a name for the service and a reference to its Dockerfile. For example:

```
services:
  my-app:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
```

4. Inside the service configuration, you can specify any other options you want such as environment variables, volumes, ports, etc. For example:

```
services:
  my-app:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    environment:
      - ENV_VAR_1=value
      - ENV_VAR_2=value
    volumes:
      - ./app:/app
    ports:
     - "5000:5000"
```

5. Save the `docker-compose.yml` file and run it using `docker-compose up`. This will build the image based on the Dockerfile and start the container with the specified configuration.

Note: This is just a basic example and you can add more services, networks, and other configurations to your docker-compose.yml as needed.

1. Create a new file in `/etc/init.d/` called `filebrowser`:

```
#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="filebrowser"
command="/usr/bin/filebrowser"
command_args="--database /var/lib/filebrowser/filebrowser.db"

pidfile="/run/${name}.pid"
command_background="true"

depend() {
    need net
}

start_pre() {

}
```

```sh

```

5. Update the available services:

```sh
rc-update --stack add filebrowser default
```

6. Start the `filebrowser` service:

```sh
rc-service filebrowser start
```

帮我用python写三个接口，具体要求：
接口1：输入文件名，文件内容，将文件内容和文件名称存入模型，下次请求继续存入该模型，该模型用于文件相似度搜索，可以存入多个文件
接口2：输入搜索语句，加载接口1生成的模型文件，返回之前存入所有文件的相似度排名，按照高低排序，可设置返回几个文件
接口3：输入文件名，可以删除相应文件名的索引，下次加载模型，搜索相似的语句该文件不被搜索到。
接口用post请求。

为了实现这三个接口，我们首先需要创建一个后端使用 Flask 或 FastAPI，这里我将使用 FastAPI。接着，我们需要自然语言处理库如-gensim来计算文本相似度。首先需要安装所需库:

```bash
pip install fastapi uvicorn gensim
```

接下来，创建一个名为 `main.py` 的文件并添加以下代码：

```python
from typing import List

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

from gensim import corpora, models, similarities

app = FastAPI()

# 存储文件内容的全局字典
file_contents = {}

class File(BaseModel):
    filename: str
    content: str

class Query(BaseModel):
    query: str
    top_n: int

@app.post("/add_file/")
async def add_file(file: File):
    # 将文件添加到全局字典中
    file_contents[file.filename] = file.content
    return {"status": "File added successfully"}

@app.post("/search/")
async def search(query: Query):
    # 加载模型
    dictionary = corpora.Dictionary([content.split() for content in file_contents.values()])
    corpus = [dictionary.doc2bow(text.split()) for text in file_contents.values()]

    tfidf = models.TfidfModel(corpus)
    index = similarities.SparseMatrixSimilarity(tfidf[corpus], num_features=len(dictionary))

    vec_bow = dictionary.doc2bow(query.query.split())
    vec_tfidf = tfidf[vec_bow]

    # 计算相似度
    similarities_list = index[vec_tfidf]

    # 排序结果
    sorted_similarities = sorted(enumerate(similarities_list), key=lambda x: -x[1])

    # 获取top_n结果
    top_n_results = list(sorted_similarities)[:query.top_n]

    # 返回结果
    result = [{'filename': file, 'similarity': score} for idx, (file, content) in enumerate(file_contents.items()) if (idx, score) in top_n_results]

    return result

@app.post("/delete_file/")
async def delete_file(filename: str):
    if filename in file_contents:
        del file_contents[filename]
        return {"status": "File deleted successfully"}
    else:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="File not found")
```

最后, 使用以下命令运行服务器：

```bash
uvicorn main:app --reload
```

这将启动一个可以访问的 `http://localhost:8000` 的服务器。现在你可以尝试使用你喜欢单的post工具，例如curl或者postman，也可以使用FastAPI默认生成的用于测试的SwaggerUI。注意这里的文本相似度是使用TF-IDF算法，您可以根据需求选择不同的算法。

The derivative of the function f(x) = e^(2x) using the chain rule can be found by following these steps:

Step 1: Identify the outer function and the inner function.
In this case, the outer function is e^u and the inner function is 2x. We can rewrite f(x) as f(x) = e^u, where u = 2x.

Step 2: Differentiate the outer function with respect to u.
The derivative of e^u with respect to u is e^u. 

Step 3: Differentiate the inner function with respect to x.
The derivative of 2x with respect to x is 2.

Step 4: Apply the chain rule.
The chain rule states that the derivative of a composite function is the derivative of the outer function evaluated at the inner function times the derivative of the inner function, or
          f'(x) = (d(e^u)/du) * (du/dx)

Substitute the expressions we found in Steps 2 and 3:
          f'(x) = (e^u) * 2

Step 5: Rewrite the expression using the original variable x.
Recall that we defined u = 2x, so substitute this back into the expression:
          f'(x) = e^(2x) * 2

So the derivative of the function f(x) = e^(2x) is f'(x) = e^(2x).

Is it possible to build a ZFS pool that contains two fast SSDs, and one slower disk, so that a user can get very fast reads and writes but still be able to tolerate the loss of disks due to redundancy on the slower disk?

Yes, it is possible to build a ZFS pool that contains both fast SSDs and slower disks, and still provide redundancy. This is known as a hybrid pool, and it allows the user to take advantage of the speed benefits of SSDs while still having the data protection of RAID.

To create a hybrid pool, you would simply add the SSDs and slower disk to a single pool, and then configure the appropriate RAID level to provide redundancy. For example, you could create a pool with mirrored vdevs consisting of the two SSDs, and a single parity vdev consisting of the slower disk.

The ZFS algorithm would then automatically distribute data across the different vdevs based on their performance characteristics, ensuring that frequently accessed data stays on the faster SSDs, while less frequently accessed data is stored on the slower disk with parity protection.

Overall, this approach can provide a good balance of speed and data protection, making it an attractive option for many users.

她们选定的那个周末，太阳高照，阳光洒在身上暖洋洋的。她们提前准备好漂亮的裙子、配饰和化妆品，然后搭乘公交车，兴高采烈地踏上了寻找美景的旅程。

在郊外的公交车站下车后，她们跟着指示牌顺着小径走去。一路上，初春的气息扑面而来，周围群山抱翠，蜿蜒的溪流欢快地唱着歌，空气中弥漫着泥土的清新味道。这种亲近自然的感觉让她们心情异常愉悦。

走了大约半小时，她们终于来到了那片桃花林。泛着粉嫩的色彩的桃花，在阳光的映射下，显得愈发娇嫩动人。她们站在桃花林中，感受着这种难得的美境，都忍不住感叹：“这真是人间仙境啊！”

终究，太阳开始落山，她们不舍的告别这片美丽的桃花林。踏上归途的时候，她们看着那一张张美丽的照片，忍不住又重新回味了那些美好瞬间。她们知道这是她们共同回忆中的一段美丽的篇章，无论将来有多远，只要翻开相册，她们又会回到那个阳光灿烂的春天。

在未来的日子里，小梅和小燕还会继续走过很多春天。即使她们各自远行，也总有一天会在桃花盛开的季节再次相聚。而那些美好的回忆，将永远成为她们生命中最珍贵的财富。

森罗万象是一个中文成语，意为万物皆有其位，形容世间万物，无所不在、无所不容。该成语源自《尚书·曾子》：“夏之时，万物作荣，冬之时，万物作枯，非不时也，故物有不得其时者也。”

这个成语也可以用来形容万事万物的复杂性和多样性，形容世界的绚烂多彩、繁复多变。在后来，这个成语也常常用来形容人物或事物的多样性和丰富性。

Gouvernait avec justesse et générosité son royaume sucré.
Offrant aux enfants, des montagnes de crème fondue,

La pistache ennoblit sa couronne scintillante.
Des rayons de soleil s'échappent de ses prunelles,

TypeError: list indices must be integers or slices, not str

This error occurs when you try to access a list using a string value as the index. In Python, lists are indexed using integer or slice values, not string values. 

For example, consider the following code:

```
my_list = ["apple", "banana", "cherry"]
fruit = my_list["apple"]
```

Here, we are trying to access the value "apple" in the list using the string value "apple" as the index. This will result in a TypeError, because list indices must be integers or slices, not str.

To fix this error, you need to use an integer or slice value as the index to access the list:

```
my_list = ["apple", "banana", "cherry"]
fruit = my_list[0]
```

In this case, the value "apple" is the first element in the list, so we use the integer value 0 as the index to access it.

Quelle est l'histoire du pantalon chino?

L'histoire du pantalon chino remonte au milieu du 19e siècle lors de la guerre hispano-américaine aux Philippines. Les soldats américains portaient des pantalons de couleur kaki qui étaient appelés "Pantalones chinos" par les Espagnols, en raison du tissu importé de Chine. Les soldats américains ont ensuite adopté le terme "chino" pour décrire le pantalon.

Le tissu de chino est généralement fait de coton sergé, ce qui le rend léger, confortable et durable. Les pantalons chino sont conçus pour être simples, avec des poches latérales et une coupe droite. La couleur traditionnelle des chinos est le kaki, bien qu'ils soient désormais disponibles dans une variété de couleurs.

Après la guerre, les soldats américains ont ramené les pantalons chino aux États-Unis et les ont popularisés comme vêtements de loisirs et d'affaires décontractés. Dans les années 1950 et 1960, les chinos sont devenus populaires parmi les étudiants des universités et les icônes de style, solidifiant leur place dans la garde-robe masculine moderne.

Aujourd'hui, les pantalons chino sont portés dans le monde entier et sont appréciées pour leur confort, leur simplicité et leur polyvalence. Ils sont souvent associés à un style décontracté, mais peuvent également être habillés avec une chemise boutonnée et une veste pour un look plus formel.
